<!--
==========================================================================
  DUAL-REFERENCE RNA-seq ANALYSIS PIPELINE
  Short genome: Ccap.2.1  |  Long genome: CCAP_1982

  Result object structure:
    results_all[["short"]][["contrast_name"]]
    results_all[["long"]][["contrast_name"]]

  Sections
    0.  Setup — libraries, palettes, themes, global helpers
    1.  Developmental timepoint confirmation
    2.  GO annotation preparation
    3.  Data import & global parameters
    4.  Q1 – Maternal-to-zygotic transition (MZT)
    5.  Q2 – Sexual dimorphism across germline and soma
    6.  Q3 – Post-mating transcriptional remodelling in females
    7.  Q4 – Transcriptional determinants of phenotypic maleness
    8.  Tissue-specific transcriptional landscapes
    9.  Global tissue atlas (PCA / UMAP across all tissues)
   10.  Tissue-specificity scores (tau index)
   11.  UpSet plot – sex-biased gene overlap across tissues
   12.  Transcription factor enrichment (HOMER motifs)
   13.  Cross-tissue correlation matrix (germline vs soma)
   14.  Drosophila sex-determination orthologue mapping

  Note: the Y-chromosome candidate gene screen that was originally part of
  this analysis has been split out into a companion repository
  (ccap-y-chromosome-synteny) and is not included here.
==========================================================================
-->

# Setup {.tabset}

## Libraries

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  # Core data wrangling
  library(tidyverse)
  library(here)
  library(tibble)

  # RNA-seq / DE
  library(edgeR)
  library(limma)
  library(DESeq2)          # used for VST in global atlas section
  library(matrixStats)

  # Dimensionality reduction
  library(umap)            # NEW: Section 10

  # Clustering & heatmaps
  library(pheatmap)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(ggdendro)
  library(dynamicTreeCut)  # for MZT WGCNA-style modules
  library(mclust)          # Gaussian mixture for landscape classification

  # GO enrichment
  library(topGO)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(GO.db)

  # Visualisation
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(ggh4x)
  library(patchwork)
  library(forcats)
  library(EnhancedVolcano)
  library(UpSetR)
  library(gghalves)
  library(ggforce)
  library(ggtext)
  library(cowplot)
  library(tidytext)

  # Plot statistics
  library(dplyr)
  library(rstatix)
  library(multcompView)
  # Tissue specificity
  # tau() implemented manually below — no extra package needed

  # Motif enrichment (Section 13)
  # Requires HOMER installed externally; R calls via system()
})
```

## Global helper functions

```{r helpers}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# clean_ids  — strip genome-specific prefixes for consistent gene matching
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
clean_ids <- function(x, strip_prefix = TRUE) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  if (strip_prefix) {
    x <- sub("^gene-", "", x)
    x <- sub("^CCAP1982_", "", x)
  }
  trimws(x)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# run_reference_analysis
#   Full edgeR QL pipeline: filter → normalise → dispersion → fit → contrasts
#   Returns nested list: dge, fit, logcpm, pca, contrasts[[name]]
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
run_reference_analysis <- function(count_matrix,
                                   metadata,
                                   design,
                                   contrast_list,
                                   prefix,
                                   outdir,
                                   plot_grouping_value = "group",
                                   min_count   = 10,
                                   min_samples = 2,
                                   fdr_thresh  = 0.05,
                                   lfc_thresh  = 1,
                                   label_top_n = 15,
                                   positive_label = "Up",
                                   negative_label = "Down",
                                   top_n = 100) {

  message("\n============================")
  message("Reference: ", prefix)
  message("============================")

  dge  <- DGEList(counts = count_matrix)
  keep <- rowSums(dge$counts >= min_count) >= min_samples
  dge  <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  message("Genes retained after filtering: ", nrow(dge))

  dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
  dge <- estimateDisp(dge, design, robust = TRUE)
  fit <- glmQLFit(dge, design, robust = TRUE)

  logcpm <- cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)

  # ---- PCA ----------------------------------------------------------------
  pca        <- prcomp(t(logcpm), scale. = TRUE)
  var_exp    <- pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)
  pc1v       <- round(var_exp[1] * 100, 1)
  pc2v       <- round(var_exp[2] * 100, 1)

  pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:2]) %>%
    rownames_to_column("id") %>%
    left_join(metadata, by = "id")

  grp_vals <- na.omit(unique(pca_df[[plot_grouping_value]]))
  pal      <- setNames(okabe_ito_palette(length(grp_vals)), grp_vals)

  p_pca <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2,
                               colour = .data[[plot_grouping_value]],
                               label  = id)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_text_repel(size = 2.8, max.overlaps = 15) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal) +
    labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", pc1v, "%)"),
         y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2v, "%)"),
         colour = "") +
    plot_theme
  ggsave(file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_PCA.pdf")), p_pca,
         width = 7, height = 5)

  # ---- MDS (legacy QC) ----------------------------------------------------
  pdf(file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_MDS.pdf")), width = 7, height = 6)
  grp_factor <- factor(metadata[[plot_grouping_value]])
  plotMDS(logcpm,
          labels = metadata$id,
          col    = okabe_ito_palette(nlevels(grp_factor))[grp_factor])
  dev.off()

  # ---- Contrasts ----------------------------------------------------------
  contrast_results <- list()

  for (cname in names(contrast_list)) {
    message("  Contrast: ", cname)
    cmat <- makeContrasts(contrasts = contrast_list[[cname]], levels = design)
    qlf  <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = cmat)

    pos_label <- trimws(strsplit(contrast_list[[cname]], "-")[[1]][1])
    neg_label <- trimws(strsplit(contrast_list[[cname]], "-")[[1]][2])

    res <- topTags(qlf, n = Inf)$table %>%
      rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
      mutate(DE_status = case_when(
        FDR < fdr_thresh & logFC >=  lfc_thresh ~ pos_label,
        FDR < fdr_thresh & logFC <= -lfc_thresh ~ neg_label,
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      ))

    write_tsv(res,
              file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_", cname, "_edgeR.tsv")))

    # MA plot
    pdf(file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_", cname, "_MA.pdf")),
        width = 7, height = 5)
    status <- limma::decideTests(qlf, p.value = fdr_thresh)
    plotMD(qlf, status = status, values = c(-1, 1),
           col  = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00"),
           main = paste(prefix, cname))
    abline(h = c(-lfc_thresh, lfc_thresh), lty = 2)
    dev.off()

        # Volcano
      top_up <- res %>%
    filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, logFC > lfc_thresh) %>%
    arrange(FDR) %>%
    slice_head(n = label_top_n)
  
  top_down <- res %>%
    filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, logFC < -lfc_thresh) %>%
    arrange(FDR) %>%
    slice_head(n = label_top_n)
  
  top_labels <- bind_rows(top_up, top_down)
  

    p_vol <- ggplot(res, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(FDR), colour = DE_status)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_thresh, lfc_thresh), linetype = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr_thresh), linetype = 2) +
    geom_label_repel(
      data = top_labels,
      aes(label = gene),
      size = 2,
      max.overlaps = 50,
      fill = "white",
      colour = "black",
      label.size = 0.2,
      box.padding = 0.35,
      point.padding = 0.2
    ) +
    volcano_theme +
    scale_colour_manual(
  values = c(
    "NS" = "grey70", # forces NS to be grey 
    setNames(c("#D55E00", "#0072B2"),
             setdiff(unique(res$DE_status), "NS"))
  )
)+
    labs(
      x = "log2 fold change",
      y = "-log10(FDR)",
      colour = ""
    )
    ggsave(file.path(outdir, paste0(prefix, "_", cname, "_volcano.pdf")),
           p_vol, width = 8, height = 7)


      # Top genes from each direction
  top_up <- res %>%
 filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, abs(logFC) >= lfc_thresh)%>%
    arrange(FDR) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n)
  
  top_down <- res %>%
   filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, abs(logFC) >= lfc_thresh)%>%
    arrange(FDR) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n)
  
  sig_genes <- bind_rows(top_up, top_down) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
    sig_genes <- res %>%
      mutate(p_n = case_when(
        logFC >=  lfc_thresh ~ neg_label,
        logFC <= -lfc_thresh ~ pos_label,
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      )) %>%
      group_by(p_n) %>%
      filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, abs(logFC) >= lfc_thresh) %>%
      arrange(FDR) %>%
      slice_head(n = 100) %>%
      pull(gene)

    if (length(sig_genes) >= 2) {
      mat_hm <- logcpm[sig_genes[sig_genes %in% rownames(logcpm)], ,
                       drop = FALSE]
      mat_hm <- t(scale(t(mat_hm)))

      
if (!plot_grouping_value %in% names(annotation_colours)) {
  grouping_levels <- unique(metadata[[plot_grouping_value]])
  grouping_levels <- grouping_levels[!is.na(grouping_levels)]
  annotation_colours[[plot_grouping_value]] <-
    setNames(okabe_ito_palette(length(grouping_levels)), grouping_levels)
}

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  df = metadata[, plot_grouping_value, drop = FALSE],
  col = annotation_colours[plot_grouping_value],
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    title = NULL
  ),
  na_col = "grey70"
)

ht <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  mat_hm,
  name = "Z-score",
  top_annotation = ha,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  column_names_rot = 45,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  column_title = NULL,
  col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#56B4E9", "white", "#E69F00"))
)

pdf(file.path(outdir,
              paste0(prefix, "_", cname, "_heatmap.pdf")),
    width = 8, height = 10)
draw(ht)
dev.off()

  
    }

    summary_tbl <- tibble(
      contrast   = cname,
      reference  = prefix,
      n_tested   = nrow(res),
      n_up       = sum(res$DE_status == pos_label),
      n_down     = sum(res$DE_status == neg_label),
      n_sig_total = sum(res$FDR < fdr_thresh)
    )

    contrast_results[[cname]] <- list(
      contrast_string = contrast_list[[cname]],
      qlf     = qlf,
      table   = res,
      summary = summary_tbl,
      volcano = p_vol
    )
  }

  list(dge = dge, design = design, fit = fit, logcpm = logcpm,
       pca = pca, contrasts = contrast_results)
}

#---------------
# compare_references_per_contrast
#   Short vs long logFC scatter + concordance metrics
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
compare_references_per_contrast <- function(short_obj, long_obj,
                                            contrast_name, outdir,
                                            gene_map_file = NULL,
                                            fdr_thresh    = 0.05) {
  short_res <- short_obj$contrasts[[contrast_name]]$table
  long_res  <- long_obj$contrasts[[contrast_name]]$table

  if (!is.null(gene_map_file) && file.exists(gene_map_file)) {
    gene_map <- read_tsv(gene_map_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
    short_cmp <- rename(short_res, short_gene_id = gene,
                        logFC_short = logFC, FDR_short = FDR,
                        logCPM_short = logCPM, DE_status_short = DE_status)
    long_cmp  <- rename(long_res,  long_gene_name = gene,
                        logFC_long = logFC, FDR_long = FDR,
                        logCPM_long = logCPM, DE_status_long = DE_status)
    compare_df <- gene_map %>%
      inner_join(short_cmp, by = "short_gene_id") %>%
      inner_join(long_cmp,  by = "long_gene_name")
  } else {
    shared <- intersect(short_res$gene, long_res$gene)
    short_cmp <- short_res %>% filter(gene %in% shared) %>%
      rename(gene_shared = gene, logFC_short = logFC, FDR_short = FDR,
             logCPM_short = logCPM, DE_status_short = DE_status)
    long_cmp  <- long_res  %>% filter(gene %in% shared) %>%
      rename(gene_shared = gene, logFC_long  = logFC, FDR_long  = FDR,
             logCPM_long  = logCPM, DE_status_long  = DE_status)
    compare_df <- inner_join(short_cmp, long_cmp, by = "gene_shared")
  }

  if (nrow(compare_df) == 0) return(NULL)

  r_pearson  <- cor(compare_df$logFC_short, compare_df$logFC_long)
  r_spearman <- cor(compare_df$logFC_short, compare_df$logFC_long,
                    method = "spearman")

  p <- ggplot(compare_df, aes(logFC_short, logFC_long)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2, colour = "grey40") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE,
                colour = "#D55E00") +
    geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +
    labs(title   = paste(contrast_name, "— short vs long"),
         subtitle = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(r_pearson, 3),
                           "  |  Spearman ρ = ", round(r_spearman, 3)),
         x = "log₂FC (short)", y = "log₂FC (long)") +
    plot_theme
  ggsave(file.path(outdir,
                   paste0("short_vs_long_", contrast_name, "_logFC.pdf")),
         p, width = 6, height = 5)

  summary_tbl <- tibble(
    contrast           = contrast_name,
    n_compared         = nrow(compare_df),
    pearson_logFC      = r_pearson,
    spearman_logFC     = r_spearman,
    short_sig          = sum(compare_df$FDR_short < fdr_thresh),
    long_sig           = sum(compare_df$FDR_long  < fdr_thresh),
    concordant_sig     = sum(compare_df$FDR_short < fdr_thresh &
                               compare_df$FDR_long  < fdr_thresh)
  )

  list(table = compare_df, summary = summary_tbl, scatter = p)
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GO enrichment helpers  (topGO wrapper + clusterProfiler wrapper)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Parse topGO p-value strings
parse_topgo_p <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("< 1e-30", "<1e-30")] <- "1e-30"
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Run topGO for one gene set / one ontology
run_topgo <- function(target_genes, gene_universe, geneID2GO,
                      ontology = "BP") {
  target_genes <- intersect(clean_ids(target_genes), gene_universe)
  if (length(target_genes) < 2) return(NULL)

  gene_list <- factor(as.integer(gene_universe %in% target_genes),
                      levels = c(0, 1))
  names(gene_list) <- gene_universe

  GOdata <- new("topGOdata", ontology = ontology, allGenes = gene_list,
                annot = annFUN.gene2GO, gene2GO = geneID2GO)
  result <- runTest(GOdata, algorithm = "weight01", statistic = "fisher")

  tibble::as_tibble(GenTable(GOdata, weight01_fisher = result,
                             orderBy = "weight01_fisher", topNodes = 30))
}

# Run all three ontologies
run_topgo_all_ont <- function(target_genes, gene_universe, geneID2GO) {
  list(
    BP = run_topgo(target_genes, gene_universe, geneID2GO, "BP"),
    MF = run_topgo(target_genes, gene_universe, geneID2GO, "MF"),
    CC = run_topgo(target_genes, gene_universe, geneID2GO, "CC")
  )
}

# Plot one ontology result as a bubble plot
plot_one_topgo <- function(topgo_df, title_text,
                           n_show = 8, wrap_width = 40) {
  if (is.null(topgo_df) || nrow(topgo_df) == 0) return(NULL)
  df <- topgo_df %>%
    mutate(p_value = parse_topgo_p(weight01_fisher),
           Significant = as.numeric(Significant)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(p_value), !is.na(Significant)) %>%
    arrange(p_value) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_show) %>%
    mutate(Description = str_wrap(Term, wrap_width),
           Description = fct_reorder(Description, Significant),
           logp = -log10(p_value))

  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  ggplot(df, aes(Description, Significant, size = Significant, fill = logp)) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, alpha = 0.9, colour = "black") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = title_text, x = NULL, y = "Gene count",
         fill = expression(-log[10](p))) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = enrichment_palette(100)) +
    plot_theme
  
  
}

# plotting summary go term barchart
plot_topgo_bar <- function(topgo_df,  title_text = "GO term summary",
                           n_show = 12, wrap_width = 45) {
  
  topgo_df <- topgo_df$BP
  if (is.null(topgo_df) || nrow(topgo_df) == 0) return(NULL)
 
  df <- topgo_df %>%
    mutate(p_value     = parse_topgo_p(weight01_fisher),
           Significant = as.numeric(Significant)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(p_value), !is.na(Significant)) %>%
    arrange(p_value) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_show) %>%
    mutate(Term = str_wrap(Term, wrap_width),
           Term = fct_reorder(Term, Significant),
           logp = -log10(p_value))
 
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
 

      
  ggplot(df, aes(Term, Significant, fill = logp)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = enrichment_palette(100),
                         name = expression(-log[10](p))) +
    labs(title = title_text, x = NULL, y = "Significant genes") +
    plot_theme +
    theme(
      # slightly more compact for the summary role
      plot.title      = element_text(size = rel(0.95)),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size = rel(0.85)),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm")
    )
}

# Patchwork panel: BP / MF / CC stacked
plot_topgo_panel <- function(ont_list, panel_title,
                             n_show = 8, wrap_width = 40) {
  plots <- lapply(c("BP", "MF", "CC"), function(ont)
    plot_one_topgo(ont_list[[ont]],
                   paste0(panel_title, " — ", ont),
                   n_show, wrap_width))
  plots <- Filter(Negate(is.null), plots)
  if (length(plots) == 0) return(NULL)
  wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 1)
}

# Up / Down side-by-side and saved to file
save_go_panel <- function(up_list, down_list, outdir, label,
                          n_show = 8) {
  p_up   <- plot_topgo_panel(up_list,   paste(label, "Up"),   n_show)
  p_down <- plot_topgo_panel(down_list, paste(label, "Down"), n_show)
  plots  <- Filter(Negate(is.null), list(p_up, p_down))
  if (length(plots) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  p_combined <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = length(plots))
  ggsave(file.path(outdir, paste0("GO_", label, "_combined.pdf")),
         p_combined, width = 9 * length(plots), height = 14,
         limitsize = FALSE)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tau tissue-specificity index (Yanai et al. 2005)
#   tau = 0  →  ubiquitously expressed
#   tau = 1  →  tissue-specific
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_tau <- function(expr_matrix) {
  # expr_matrix: genes × tissues (mean CPM or TPM per tissue)
  apply(expr_matrix, 1, function(x) {
    x[x < 0] <- 0
    if (max(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
    n <- length(x)
    (sum(1 - x / max(x))) / (n - 1)
  })
}
```

# - 
#  Developmental timepoint confirmation

> Verify that embryo timepoints are **non-overlapping sequential windows** (0–1 h, 1–2 h, …) and not cumulative intervals.

```{r dev_confirm, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
outdir <- here("04_results/11_developmental_confirmation")
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Load raw counts & metadata
expr <- read_tsv(
  here("02_preprocessing/05_results_summary/short_read_genome/salmon.merged.gene_counts.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = names(.)[1]) %>%
  as.matrix()
mode(expr) <- "numeric"

meta_dev <- read_csv(here("01_data/metadata.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(tissue == "EG", experiment == "2") %>%
  filter(id %in% colnames(expr))

expr_dev <- expr[, meta_dev$id, drop = FALSE]
expr_dev <- expr_dev[rowSums(expr_dev) > 0, ]
expr_log  <- log2(expr_dev + 1)

# Top 5,000 variable genes for PCA
top5k <- names(sort(rowVars(expr_log), decreasing = TRUE))[1:min(5000, nrow(expr_log))]
pca   <- prcomp(t(expr_log[top5k, ]), scale. = TRUE)
var_e <- pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)

meta_dev$age <- factor(meta_dev$age,
                       levels = sort(unique(meta_dev$age)))
age_cols <- setNames(okabe_ito_palette(nlevels(meta_dev$age)),
                     levels(meta_dev$age))

pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("id") %>%
  left_join(meta_dev, by = "id")

p_pca_dev <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = factor(age), label = id)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 15) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = age_cols) +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_e[1]*100,1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_e[2]*100,1), "%)"),
       colour = "Timepoint (h)",
       title = "Embryo developmental timepoints — PCA") +
  plot_theme

p_pca_dev
ggsave(file.path(outdir, "PCA_embryo_timepoints.pdf"), p_pca_dev,
       width = 8, height = 6)

# Sample correlation heatmap
cor_mat <- cor(expr_log[top5k, ], method = "spearman")
ann_row  <- data.frame(age = meta_dev$age, row.names = meta_dev$id)

         
pdf(
  file.path(outdir, "sample_correlation_heatmap.pdf"),
  width = 9,
  height = 8
)
pheatmap(cor_mat,
         annotation_row = ann_row,
         annotation_col = ann_row,
         annotation_colors = list(age = age_cols),
         clustering_method = "ward.D2",
         color    = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#0072B2"))(100),
         fontsize = 8,
)

dev.off()
# Mean expression trajectory for top 20 variable genes
gene_var_dev <- rowVars(expr_log)
top20_genes  <- names(sort(gene_var_dev, decreasing = TRUE))[1:50]

traj_df <- expr_log[top20_genes, ] %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "id", values_to = "log2cpm") %>%
  left_join(meta_dev, by = "id")

p_traj <- ggplot(traj_df, aes(factor(age), log2cpm,
                                colour = gene)) +
  
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.15, position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.15, aes(group = gene), position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", aes(group = 1), size = 0.8) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 2, aes(group = 1)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2, aes(group = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Timepoint (h)", y = "log₂(counts + 1)") +
  scale_color_manual(values = okabe_ito_palette(50)) +
  plot_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_traj
ggsave(file.path(outdir, "top20_trajectory.pdf"), p_traj,
       width = 8, height = 5)

message("Developmental confirmation complete.")
```

#  GO annotation preparation

```{r go_setup, eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# ---- eggNOG-mapper annotation (primary) -----------------------------------
# Expected input: eggNOG output TSV for both short and long genome proteins
# Parsed to gene2go list for topGO

outdir_go <- here("data/GO_terms/eggNOG-mapper/parsed_gene2go")
dir.create(outdir_go, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

parse_eggnog <- function(eggnog_tsv, gff_file, genome = "short") {

  # Read GFF to build protein → gene map
  gff <- read_tsv(gff_file, comment = "#",
                  col_names = c("seqid","source","type","start","end",
                                "score","strand","phase","attributes"),
                  show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(type == "CDS") %>%
    mutate(
      protein = str_extract(attributes, "(?<=protein_id=)[^;]+"),
      gene    = str_extract(attributes, "(?<=gene=)[^;]+"),
      locus   = str_extract(attributes, "(?<=locus_tag=)[^;]+"),
      gene_id = coalesce(gene, locus)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(protein), !is.na(gene_id)) %>%
    # strip CCAP1982_ prefix for long genome
    mutate(gene_id = if (genome == "long")
             sub("^CCAP1982_", "", gene_id) else gene_id) %>%
    distinct(protein, gene_id)

  prot2gene <- setNames(gff$gene_id, gff$protein)

  # Read eggNOG TSV
  egg <- read_tsv(eggnog_tsv, comment = "##", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::select(query = 1, GOs = contains("GOs")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(GOs), GOs != "-")

  # Expand GO terms
  egg_long <- egg %>%
    mutate(GO_list = str_split(GOs, ",")) %>%
    unnest(GO_list) %>%
    mutate(
      GO_list  = trimws(GO_list),
      gene_id  = prot2gene[query]
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene_id), str_starts(GO_list, "GO:")) %>%
    distinct(gene_id, go_id = GO_list)

  write_tsv(egg_long,
            file.path(outdir_go,
                      paste0("medfly_", genome, "_gene2go_compact.tsv")))

  split(egg_long$go_id, egg_long$gene_id)
}

geneID2GO_short <- parse_eggnog(
 here("data/GO_terms/eggNOG-mapper/medfly_short.emapper.annotations"),
  here("data/Genomic_files/GCF_000347755.3_Ccap_2.1_genomic.gff.gz"),
  genome = "short"
)
geneID2GO_long  <- parse_eggnog(
  here("data/GO_terms/eggNOG-mapper/medfly_long.emapper.annotations"),
  here("data/Genomic_files/GCA_905071925.1_EGII-3.2.1_genomic.gff.gz"),
  genome = "long"
)

saveRDS(geneID2GO_short, here("02_preprocessing/04_go_annotation/geneID2GO_short.rds"))
saveRDS(geneID2GO_long,  here("02_preprocessing/04_go_annotation/geneID2GO_long.rds"))
message("GO annotation setup complete.")
```

# DE Stats table
```{r de_stats_accumulator, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# RUNNING DE STATISTICS TABLE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Every contrast in this analysis appends one row to a single master TSV.
# This chunk initialises the file (deleting any stale version from a previous
# run) and defines the helper.  The helper is called at the end of every
# summary panel chunk, so the table grows automatically as you run sections.
#
# Output: results/final_output/DE_stats_master.tsv
#
# Columns:
#   section         – e.g. "Q1", "Q2", "Tissue_landscape", "Y_chromosome"
#   question        – human-readable label
#   genome          – "short" | "long"
#   contrast        – contrast name from run_reference_analysis
#   group_A / group_B – the two groups being compared
#   n_tested        – total genes tested
#   n_up            – genes up in group_A (logFC > lfc_thresh, FDR < fdr_thresh)
#   n_down          – genes up in group_B
#   n_sig_total     – all DE genes
#   pct_sig         – % of tested genes that are DE
# ===========================================================================


de_master_file <- file.path(outdir_raw, "DE_stats_master.tsv")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Column spec — used both for initialisation and every read-back.
# Keeping this in one place prevents the type-mismatch error that occurs when
# read_tsv() guesses columns as <chr> on an empty file.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
de_master_cols <- cols(
  section     = col_character(),
  question    = col_character(),
  genome      = col_character(),
  contrast    = col_character(),
  group_A     = col_character(),
  group_B     = col_character(),
  n_tested    = col_integer(),
  n_up        = col_integer(),
  n_down      = col_integer(),
  n_sig_total = col_integer(),
  pct_sig     = col_double()
)

# Initialise with a typed empty tibble so the header row has the right types.
# Comment out the write_tsv line to accumulate across sessions instead.
de_master_empty <- tibble(
  section     = character(), question    = character(),
  genome      = character(), contrast    = character(),
  group_A     = character(), group_B     = character(),
  n_tested    = integer(),   n_up        = integer(),
  n_down      = integer(),   n_sig_total = integer(),
  pct_sig     = numeric()
)
write_tsv(de_master_empty, de_master_file)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# append_de_stats()
#   results_obj     — the list returned by run_reference_analysis
#                     (or a list with $short / $long elements)
#   section         — e.g. "Q1", "Q2"
#   question        — plain-English contrast description
#   contrast_string — the contrast formula, e.g. "Ovary - Testes"
#   genome          — "short" | "long"
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
append_de_stats <- function(results_obj,
                             section,
                             question,
                             contrast_string,
                             genome = "short") {

  # Defensive: accept results objects that have the genome nested directly
  # OR wrapped in $short / $long
  genome_obj <- if (!is.null(results_obj[[genome]])) {
    results_obj[[genome]]
  } else {
    results_obj   # already the genome-level object
  }

  if (is.null(genome_obj$contrasts) || length(genome_obj$contrasts) == 0) {
    message("append_de_stats: no contrasts found for ", genome, " — skipping.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  if (grepl("MZT", question)) {
    cname <- contrast_string
    
  } else {
    cname <- names(genome_obj$contrasts)[1]
  }
  
  res   <- genome_obj$contrasts[[cname]]$table

  if (is.null(res) || nrow(res) == 0) {
    message("append_de_stats: empty results table — skipping.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # Split "GroupA - GroupB" cleanly (handles spaces around dash)
  parts <- trimws(strsplit(contrast_string, "\\s*-\\s*", perl = TRUE)[[1]])
  grp_A <- parts[1]
  grp_B <- if (length(parts) >= 2) paste(parts[-1], collapse = " - ") else ""

  n_up    <- sum(res$FDR < fdr_thresh & res$logFC >  lfc_thresh, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_down  <- sum(res$FDR < fdr_thresh & res$logFC < -lfc_thresh, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_tot   <- sum(res$FDR < fdr_thresh,                            na.rm = TRUE)
  n_test  <- nrow(res)

  new_row <- tibble(
    section     = as.character(section),
    question    = as.character(question),
    genome      = as.character(genome),
    contrast    = as.character(cname),
    group_A     = as.character(grp_A),
    group_B     = as.character(grp_B),
    n_tested    = as.integer(n_test),
    n_up        = as.integer(n_up),
    n_down      = as.integer(n_down),
    n_sig_total = as.integer(n_tot),
    pct_sig     = round(as.numeric(n_tot) / as.numeric(n_test) * 100, 2)
  )

  # Read back with explicit col_types so integers stay integers on empty files
  existing <- read_tsv(de_master_file,
                       col_types  = de_master_cols,
                       show_col_types = FALSE)

  write_tsv(bind_rows(existing, new_row), de_master_file)
  message(sprintf("  [DE stats] %s | %s | %s | up=%d down=%d",
                  section, genome, cname, n_up, n_down))
  invisible(new_row)
}


message("DE stats accumulator initialised: ", de_master_file)
```

# - 
#  Q1 – Maternal-to-zygotic transition (MZT)

> **Core question:** How does the transcriptome shift from maternal provisioning to embryonic control?

## C1 – Unfertilised vs. fertilised eggs

```{r q1_c1, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
outdir <- file.path(outdir_raw, "1_MZT/contrast_1")
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

meta <- meta_raw %>% filter(tissue == "EG", experiment == "1")
counts_short <- counts_short_raw[, meta$id, drop = FALSE]
counts_long  <- counts_long_raw[,  meta$id, drop = FALSE]

design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + egg_status, data = meta)
colnames(design) <- sub("egg_status", "", colnames(design))

contrast_list <- list(unfert_vs_fert = "unfertilised - fertilised")

  #positive_label <- "unfertilised"
  #negative_label <- "fertilised"
  
results_all <- list(
  short = run_reference_analysis(counts_short, meta, design, contrast_list,
                                 "short", outdir, "egg_status",
                                 min_count, min_samples, fdr_thresh, lfc_thresh),
  long  = run_reference_analysis(counts_long,  meta, design, contrast_list,
                                 "long",  outdir, "egg_status",
                                 min_count, min_samples, fdr_thresh, lfc_thresh)
)

# Concordance scatter
comparison_all <- lapply(names(contrast_list), function(cn)
  compare_references_per_contrast(results_all$short, results_all$long,
                                  cn, outdir, gene_map_file, fdr_thresh))

saveRDS(results_all, file.path(outdir, "results_all_nested.rds"))

for (g in c("short","long"))
  append_de_stats(results_all, "Q1", "Fertilised vs Unfertilised Egg",
                  contrast_list[[1]], genome = g)
```

### GO enrichment – C1

```{r q1_c1_go, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
for (genome in c("short", "long")) {
  geneID2GO  <- get(paste0("geneID2GO_",  genome))
  gene_univ  <- get(paste0("gene_universe_", genome))
  res        <- results_all[[genome]]$contrasts$unfert_vs_fert$table

  up_genes   <- res %>% filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, logFC  >  lfc_thresh) %>% pull(gene) %>% clean_ids()
  down_genes <- res %>% filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, logFC  < -lfc_thresh) %>% pull(gene) %>% clean_ids()

  go_up   <- run_topgo_all_ont(up_genes,   gene_univ, geneID2GO)
  go_down <- run_topgo_all_ont(down_genes, gene_univ, geneID2GO)

  save_go_panel(go_up, go_down,
                outdir, paste0(genome, "_unfert_vs_fert"))
  
  # outputGO 
  go_up_merged <- go_up %>% bind_rows() %>% mutate(group = "up")
  go_down_merged <- go_down %>% bind_rows()%>% mutate(group = "down")
  
  go_merged <- rbind(go_up_merged, go_down_merged)
  
  go_merged$sub_contrast <- "unfert_vs_fert"
  write_tsv(go_merged, paste0(outdir,"/",genome,"GO_terms_merged.tsv"))
}
```

## C2 – Fertilisation-dependent genes vs. core maternal transcriptome

```{r q1_c2, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
outdir_c2 <- file.path(outdir_raw, "1_MZT/contrast_2")
dir.create(outdir_c2, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# All egg samples (unfertilised = age 0; fertilised = ages 1–24)
meta_all_egg <- meta_raw %>% filter(tissue == "EG")
counts_short_egg <- counts_short_raw[, meta_all_egg$id, drop = FALSE]

dge_egg <- DGEList(counts = counts_short_egg)
keep_egg <- rowSums(dge_egg$counts >= min_count) >= min_samples
dge_egg  <- dge_egg[keep_egg, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
dge_egg  <- calcNormFactors(dge_egg)
logcpm_egg <- cpm(dge_egg, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)

# ---- Hierarchical clustering of fertilised samples to define early/late ---
meta_fert <- meta_all_egg %>% filter(age > 0)
mat_fert  <- logcpm_egg[, meta_fert$id, drop = FALSE]
top_var   <- names(sort(rowVars(mat_fert), decreasing = TRUE))[1:2000]

hc <- hclust(dist(t(mat_fert[top_var, ])), method = "ward.D2")

cluster_assign      <- cutree(hc, k = 2)
meta_fert$cluster   <- paste0("C", cluster_assign[meta_fert$id])

# Label clusters by mean age
cluster_mean_age <- meta_fert %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(mean_age = mean(as.numeric(age)), .groups = "drop")
early_cluster <- cluster_mean_age$cluster[which.min(cluster_mean_age$mean_age)]

meta_fert <- meta_fert %>%
  mutate(time_group = if_else(cluster == early_cluster, "early", "late"))

meta_grouped <- meta_all_egg %>%
  left_join(meta_fert %>% dplyr::select(id, time_group), by = "id") %>%
  mutate(time_group = coalesce(time_group,
                               if_else(age == 0, "unfertilised", NA_character_)))

# ggplot dendrogram
dend_data  <- dendro_data(hc, type = "rectangle")
labels_df  <- dend_data$labels %>%
  left_join(meta_fert %>% dplyr::select(id, age), by = c("label" = "id"))

age_cols_fert <- setNames(
  okabe_ito_palette(length(unique(labels_df$age))),
  sort(unique(labels_df$age)))

p_dend <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = dend_data$segments,
               aes(x, y, xend = xend, yend = yend)) +
  geom_text(data = labels_df,
            aes(x, y - 0.5, label = label, colour = factor(age)),
            angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 2.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = age_cols_fert, name = "Timepoint") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  labs(title = "Hierarchical clustering — fertilised egg samples") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

p_dend
ggsave(file.path(outdir_c2, "fertilised_hclust.pdf"), p_dend,
       width = 9, height = 7)

# ---- Three-group contrasts (unfert | early | late) -------------------------
counts_grp <- counts_short_raw[, meta_grouped$id[!is.na(meta_grouped$time_group)],
                                 drop = FALSE]
meta_grp   <- meta_grouped %>% filter(!is.na(time_group))

design_grp <- model.matrix(~ 0 + time_group, data = meta_grp)
colnames(design_grp) <- sub("time_group", "", colnames(design_grp))

contrast_list_grp <- list(
  early_vs_unfert = "early - unfertilised",
  late_vs_unfert  = "late  - unfertilised",
  late_vs_early   = "late  - early"
)

results_grp <- list(
  short = run_reference_analysis(counts_grp, meta_grp, design_grp,
                                 contrast_list_grp, "short", outdir_c2,
                                 "time_group", min_count, min_samples,
                                 fdr_thresh, lfc_thresh)
)

saveRDS(results_grp, file.path(outdir_c2, "results_all_nested.rds"))

# Record stats for each of the three temporal contrasts (short genome only)
contrast_list_grp1 <- list(
  "Unfertilised vs Early" = "early_vs_unfert",
  "Unfertilised vs Late"  = "late_vs_unfert",
  "Early vs Late"   = "late_vs_early"  
)

for (cname in names(contrast_list_grp1)) {
  append_de_stats(results_grp, "Q1",
                  paste("MZT :", cname),
                  contrast_list_grp1[[cname]],
                  genome = "short")
}
```

## C3 – Temporal gene modules (WGCNA-style soft-clustering)

```{r q1_c3, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
outdir_c3 <- file.path(outdir_raw, "1_MZT/contrast_3")
dir.create(outdir_c3, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Use fertilised egg samples only
meta_fert2   <- meta_raw %>% filter(tissue == "EG", age > 0)
logcpm_fert2 <- logcpm_egg[, meta_fert2$id, drop = FALSE]

# Select top 3,000 variable genes
top3k <- names(sort(rowVars(logcpm_fert2), decreasing = TRUE))[1:3000]
mat   <- logcpm_fert2[top3k, ]

# k-means with k = 3 (M1, M2, M3)
set.seed(42)
km <- kmeans(mat, centers = 3, nstart = 25, iter.max = 100)

module_df <- tibble(gene = rownames(mat), module = paste0("M", km$cluster))

# Mean expression per module per timepoint
mean_expr <- mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  left_join(module_df, by = "gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(gene, module), names_to = "id",
               values_to = "logcpm") %>%
  left_join(meta_fert2 %>% dplyr::select(id, age), by = "id")# %>%
  #group_by(module, age) %>%
  #summarise(mean_logcpm = mean(logcpm), .groups = "drop")

# Relabel modules by expression trajectory direction
# M ordered by mean age at max expression
module_order <- mean_expr %>%
  group_by(module) %>%
  filter(logcpm == max(logcpm)) %>%
  summarise(peak_age = mean(as.numeric(age)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(peak_age)

module_df <- module_df %>%
  mutate(module = factor(module, levels = module_order$module))
```

# SUMMARY PANEL 


```{r q1_summary_panel, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Q1 SUMMARY: Maternal-to-Zygotic Transition
# Three-panel figure:
#   A. PCA of all egg timepoints (unfertilised + fertilised, coloured by age)
#   B. Temporal module trajectories (M1 / M2 / M3)
#   C. DE gene count bar: unfertilised vs fertilised (short genome)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
outdir_summary <- file.path(outdir_raw, "1_MZT/summary_panels")
dir.create(outdir_summary, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---- A: PCA ----------------------------------------------------------------
meta_egg_all <- meta_raw %>% filter(tissue == "EG")
counts_egg   <- counts_short_raw[, meta_egg_all$id, drop = FALSE]
dge_egg_sum  <- DGEList(counts = counts_egg)
keep_egg_sum <- rowSums(cpm(dge_egg_sum) >= 1) >= 2
dge_egg_sum  <- dge_egg_sum[keep_egg_sum, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
dge_egg_sum  <- calcNormFactors(dge_egg_sum)
lcpm_egg_sum <- cpm(dge_egg_sum, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)

top2k_egg  <- names(sort(rowVars(lcpm_egg_sum), decreasing = TRUE))[1:2000]
pca_egg    <- prcomp(t(lcpm_egg_sum[top2k_egg, ]), scale. = TRUE)
vexp_egg   <- pca_egg$sdev^2 / sum(pca_egg$sdev^2)

pca_egg_df <- as.data.frame(pca_egg$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("id") %>%
  left_join(meta_egg_all, by = "id") %>%
  mutate(
    stage = case_when(
      age == 0  ~ "Unfertilised",
      age %in% c(1,2,3,4)  ~ "Early (1–4 h)",
      TRUE      ~ "Late (8–24 h)"
    ),
    stage = factor(stage, levels = c("Unfertilised","Early (1–4 h)","Late (8–24 h)"))
  )

stage_cols <- c("Unfertilised" = "#E69F00",
                "Early (1–4 h)" = "#56B4E9",
                "Late (8–24 h)"  = "#009E73")

pA <- ggplot(pca_egg_df, aes(PC1, PC2)) +

  # ---- 1. Convex hull shading per stage (works with n ≥ 1) ----------------
  geom_polygon(
    data = pca_egg_df %>%
      group_by(stage) %>%
      slice(chull(PC1, PC2)) %>%        # chull silently returns 1 point when n=1
      ungroup(),
    aes(fill = stage, group = stage),
    alpha = 0.12, colour = NA
  ) +

  # ---- 2. Trajectory: connect mean position of each timepoint in order -----
  # Compute per-timepoint centroid so the arrow tracks the average trajectory
  {
    traj <- pca_egg_df %>%
      group_by(age) %>%
      summarise(PC1 = mean(PC1), PC2 = mean(PC2),
                stage = dplyr::first(stage), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(as.numeric(as.character(age)))

    list(
      geom_path(data = traj,
                aes(PC1, PC2, colour = stage, group = 1),
                linewidth = 0.7,  alpha = 0.6),
      geom_segment(
        data = traj %>% slice(n()-1, n()) %>%
          summarise(x    = PC1[1], y    = PC2[1],
                    xend = PC1[2], yend = PC2[2]),
        aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
        arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"), type = "closed"),
        colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6
      )
    )
  } +

  # ---- 3. Points coloured by stage, shaped by age class --------------------
  geom_point(aes(colour = stage, shape = stage), size = 3.5, alpha = 0.9) +

  # ---- 4. Timepoint labels (age in hours) ----------------------------------
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = paste0(age, "h"), colour = stage),
    size = 2.8, show.legend = FALSE,
    box.padding = 0.3, max.overlaps = 20
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(values = stage_cols) +
  scale_fill_manual(  values = stage_cols) +
  scale_shape_manual(values  = c(16, 17, 15)) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  labs(x      = paste0("PC1 (", round(vexp_egg[1]*100, 1), "%)"),
       y      = paste0("PC2 (", round(vexp_egg[2]*100, 1), "%)"),
       colour = "Stage", shape = "Stage",
       title  = "Developmental stage separation") +
  plot_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(file.path(outdir_summary, "PCA.png"),
       pA, width = 5, height = 5)
# ---- B: Temporal modules ---------------------------------------------------
```

```{r q1_go_heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
outdir_go_summary <- file.path(outdir_raw, "1_MZT/summary_panels", "GO_heatmap")
dir.create(outdir_go_summary, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---- Load all short-genome GO summary files from Q1 -----------------------
q1_go_files <- list.files(
  path       = file.path(outdir_raw, "1_MZT"),
  pattern    = "GO_terms_merged\\.tsv$",
  recursive  = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
) %>%
  .[str_detect(., "short")]

message("Q1 GO files found: ", length(q1_go_files))
print(q1_go_files)
# should be 2 because C2 has all 3 merged 
if (length(q1_go_files) == 0) stop("No Q1 short GO files found — check paths")

# Read and label by contrast (parent folder name)
q1_go <- map_dfr(q1_go_files, function(f) {
  contrast <- basename(dirname(f))   # e.g. "contrast_1", "contrast_2"
  read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      contrast       = contrast,
      p_value        = parse_topgo_p(weight01_fisher),
      neg_log10p     = -log10(pmax(p_value, 1e-10)),
      contrast_group = paste0(sub_contrast," | ", group)
    )
  
  
})

message("Total GO rows loaded: ", nrow(q1_go))
message("Contrast-groups found:")
print(unique(q1_go$contrast_group))

# ============================================================
# Helper: make heatmap from long GO data
#   x-axis (columns) = contrast_group
#   y-axis (rows)    = GO Term
#   fill             = -log10(p)
# ============================================================
make_contrast_go_heatmap <- function(go_data,
                                     title_text,
                                     n_terms     = 30,
                                     min_groups  = 2,
                                     p_threshold = 0.05) {
  
  # Keep terms significant in at least min_groups contrast-groups
  sig_terms <- go_data %>%
    filter(p_value < p_threshold) %>%
    dplyr::count(Term) %>%
    filter(n >= min_groups) %>%
    pull(Term)
  
  # If nothing is shared, take top terms by mean enrichment instead
  if (length(sig_terms) == 0) {
    message("No shared terms across groups — taking top terms by mean enrichment")
    sig_terms <- go_data %>%
      filter(p_value < p_threshold) %>%
      group_by(Term) %>%
      summarise(mean_p = mean(neg_log10p), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(mean_p)) %>%
      slice_head(n = n_terms) %>%
      pull(Term)
  }
  
  if (length(sig_terms) == 0) {
    message("No significant GO terms found")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Build matrix: best p-value per term × contrast_group
  mat_long <- go_data %>%
    filter(Term %in% sig_terms) %>%
    group_by(Term, contrast_group) %>%
    slice_min(p_value, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(Term, contrast_group, neg_log10p)
  
  mat_wide <- mat_long %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from  = contrast_group,
                values_from = neg_log10p,
                values_fill = 0)
  
  # Select top n_terms by mean enrichment across all groups
  top_terms <- mat_wide %>%
    mutate(mean_p = rowMeans(across(-Term))) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_p)) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_terms) %>%
    pull(Term)
  
  mat <- mat_wide %>%
    filter(Term %in% top_terms) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Term") %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  mat[mat > 10] <- 10
  
  # Wrap long term names
  rownames(mat) <- str_trunc(rownames(mat), 50)
  
  # Row clustering
  if (nrow(mat) > 2) {
    row_order <- hclust(dist(mat), method = "ward.D2")$order
    mat       <- mat[row_order, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  
  pheatmap(
    mat,
    color             = colorRampPalette(c("#0072B2","white","#D55E00"))(100),
    cluster_rows      = FALSE,
    cluster_cols      = TRUE,
    clustering_method = "ward.D2",
    fontsize_row      = 9,
    fontsize_col      = 9,
    angle_col         = "45",
    main              = title_text,
    legend_breaks     = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10),
    legend_labels     = c("0","2","4","6","8","≥10")
  )
}

# ============================================================
# PLOT 1: All Q1 contrasts in one heatmap
#   Columns = contrast | group (e.g. "contrast_1 | unfert")
#   Shows which GO terms are shared across MZT contrasts
#   and which are specific to one comparison
# ============================================================
p_q1_heatmap <- make_contrast_go_heatmap(
  go_data    = q1_go,
  title_text = "MZT: GO enrichment across all contrasts\n(−log₁₀ p)",
  n_terms    = 30,
  min_groups = 2
)
p_q1_heatmap<- wrap_elements(
  full = grid.grabExpr(ComplexHeatmap::draw( p_q1_heatmap)))

if (!is.null(p_q1_heatmap)) {

  ggsave(file.path(outdir_go_summary, "Q1_GO_heatmap_all_contrasts.pdf"), p_q1_heatmap, width = 16, height = 10, dpi = 200)
  

}

# ============================================================
# PLOT 2: Faceted bar — top 8 terms per contrast-group
#   One panel per contrast-group
#   Good for seeing what each specific comparison is driven by
# ============================================================
p_q1_facet <- q1_go %>%
  filter(p_value < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(contrast_group) %>%
  slice_min(p_value, n = 8, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Term_short = str_trunc(Term, 40)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x      = reorder_within(Term_short, neg_log10p, contrast_group),
             y      = neg_log10p,
             fill   = neg_log10p)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ contrast_group, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_reordered() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = enrichment_palette(100),
                       name    = expression(-log[10](p))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    title    = "MZT: top GO terms per contrast group",
    subtitle = "Top 8 significant BP terms ( p < 0.05)",
    x = NULL, y = expression(-log[10](p))
  ) +
  plot_theme +
  theme(
    strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_q1_facet
ggsave(file.path(outdir_go_summary, "Q1_GO_faceted_per_contrast.pdf"),
       p_q1_facet, width = 14, height = 0.6 * length(unique(q1_go$contrast_group)) + 4,
       limitsize = FALSE)
```

```{r q2_c1, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
outdir <- file.path(outdir_q2, "contrast_1")

  filter(tissue %in% c("TE", "OO", "YO")) %>%
  mutate(gamete = case_when(

results_all <- list(

)
```

### GO enrichment – C1

```{r q2_c1_go, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
for (genome in c("short", "long")) {
  geneID2GO <- get(paste0("geneID2GO_",      genome))
  gene_univ <- get(paste0("gene_universe_",   genome))
  res       <- results_all[[genome]]$contrasts$female_gonad_vs_male_gonad$table
  up_g      <- res %>% filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, logFC >  lfc_thresh) %>% pull(gene) %>% clean_ids()
  down_g    <- res %>% filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, logFC < -lfc_thresh) %>% pull(gene) %>% clean_ids()
  save_go_panel(run_topgo_all_ont(up_g, gene_univ, geneID2GO),
                run_topgo_all_ont(down_g, gene_univ, geneID2GO),
                outdir, paste0(genome))
  
  
  # outputGO 
  
  go_down <- run_topgo_all_ont(down_g, gene_univ, geneID2GO)
  go_up <- run_topgo_all_ont(up_g, gene_univ, geneID2GO)
  
  go_up_merged <- go_up %>% bind_rows() %>% mutate(group = "up")
  go_down_merged <-  go_down %>% bind_rows()%>% mutate(group = "down")
  
  go_merged <- rbind(go_up_merged, go_down_merged) 
  

  write_tsv(go_merged, paste0(outdir,"/",genome,"GO_terms_merged.tsv"))
}
```

# SUMMARY PANEL 


```{r q2_summary_panel, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Q2 SUMMARY: Sexual dimorphism across germline and soma
# Four-panel figure:
#   A. Volcano: male vs female gonad (germline dimorphism)
#   B. Volcano: male vs female abdomen (somatic dimorphism, virgin)
#   C. Mirror bar: DE gene counts across all Q2 contrasts
#   D. Venn/UpSet: overlap of male-biased genes between germline and soma
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Helper: load short-genome results from a saved rds
load_short_res <- function(rds_path, contrast_name) {
  if (!file.exists(rds_path)) return(NULL)
  readRDS(rds_path)$short$contrasts[[contrast_name]]$table
}

outdir_summary <- file.path(outdir_raw, "2_Sexual_dimorphism/summary_panels")
dir.create(outdir_summary, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---- Load the four Q2 contrasts -------------------------------------------
res_germline   <- load_short_res(
  file.path(outdir_raw, "2_Sexual_dimorphism/contrast_1/results_all_nested.rds"),
  "female_gonad_vs_male_gonad"
)
res_distal_prox <- load_short_res(
  file.path(outdir_raw, "2_Sexual_dimorphism/contrast_2/results_all_nested.rds"),
  "distal_vs_proximal"
)
res_soma_virgin <- load_short_res(
  file.path(outdir_raw, "2_Sexual_dimorphism/contrast_3/results_all_nested.rds"),
  "AbdomenF_virgin_vs_AbdomenM"
)
res_soma_mated  <- load_short_res(
  file.path(outdir_raw, "2_Sexual_dimorphism/contrast_4/results_all_nested.rds"),
  "AbdomenF_mated_vs_AbdomenM"
)

# ---- A: Germline volcano ---------------------------------------------------
make_summary_volcano <- function(res, title_text,
                                 pos_lab = "Female-biased",
                                 neg_lab = "Male-biased") {
  if (is.null(res)) {
    return(ggplot() +
             annotate("text", x=0.5, y=0.5, label="Data not found", size=4) +
             theme_void() + labs(title = title_text))
  }

  # Top labels by FDR in each direction
  labels_df <- bind_rows(
    res %>% filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, logFC >  lfc_thresh) %>%
      arrange(FDR) %>% slice_head(n = 8),
    res %>% filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, logFC < -lfc_thresh) %>%
      arrange(FDR) %>% slice_head(n = 8)
  )

  res <- res %>%
    mutate(group = case_when(
      FDR < fdr_thresh & logFC >  lfc_thresh ~ pos_lab,
      FDR < fdr_thresh & logFC < -lfc_thresh ~ neg_lab,
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    ))

  n_pos  <- sum(res$group == pos_lab)
  n_neg  <- sum(res$group == neg_lab)

  ggplot(res, aes(logFC, -log10(FDR), colour = group)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_thresh, lfc_thresh),
               linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr_thresh),
               linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
    geom_label_repel(data = labels_df,
                     aes(label = gene),
                     size = 2.2, fill = "white",
                     colour = "black", label.size = 0.15,
                     max.overlaps = 20,
                     box.padding = 0.3) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(
      setNames("#D55E00", pos_lab),
      setNames("#0072B2",       neg_lab),
      "NS" = "grey80"
    )) +
    annotate(
  "label",
  x = max(res$logFC, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.85,
  y = max(-log10(res$FDR), na.rm = TRUE) * 0.3,
  label = paste0(pos_lab, "\nn = ", scales::comma(n_pos)),
  size = 3,
  colour = "#D55E00",
  fill = "grey95",
  label.size = 0.15,
  hjust = 1
) +
annotate(
  "label",
  x = min(res$logFC, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.85,
  y = max(-log10(res$FDR), na.rm = TRUE) * 0.3,
  label = paste0(neg_lab, "\nn = ", scales::comma(n_neg)),
  size = 3,
  colour = "#0072B2",
  fill = "grey95",
  label.size = 0.15,
  hjust = 0
) +
    labs(x = "log₂FC", y = "-log₁₀(FDR)",
         colour = NULL, title = title_text) +
    plot_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

pA_q2 <- make_summary_volcano(
  res_germline,
  "Germline: Ovary vs Testes",
  pos_lab = "Ovary-biased",
  neg_lab = "Testis-biased"
)
ggsave(file.path(outdir_summary, "Q2_plotA.png"),
       pA_q2, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 200)
pB_q2 <- make_summary_volcano(
  res_soma_virgin,
  "Soma (Abdomen): Male vs Female",
  pos_lab = "Female-biased",
  neg_lab = "Male-biased"
)
ggsave(file.path(outdir_summary, "Q2_plotB.png"),
       pB_q2, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 200)
# ---- C: Mirror bar — DE counts across all contrasts -----------------------
q2_contrast_meta <- tribble(
  ~label,                          ~rds_path,                                            ~contrast_name,
  "Germline\n(Testes vs Ovary)",   "2_Sexual_dimorphism/contrast_1/results_all_nested.rds", "female_gonad_vs_male_gonad",
  
  "Ovary axis\n(Proximal vs Distal)",  "2_Sexual_dimorphism/contrast_2/results_all_nested.rds", "distal_vs_proximal",
  
  "Soma - \n Male vs virgin female", "2_Sexual_dimorphism/contrast_3/results_all_nested.rds", "AbdomenF_virgin_vs_AbdomenM",
  
  "Soma - \n Male vs mated female", "2_Sexual_dimorphism/contrast_4/results_all_nested.rds", "AbdomenF_mated_vs_AbdomenM",
)

de_counts_q2 <- pmap_dfr(q2_contrast_meta, function(label, rds_path, contrast_name) {
  res <- load_short_res(file.path(outdir_raw, rds_path), contrast_name)
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
  tibble(
    contrast = label,
    n_up   = sum(res$FDR < fdr_thresh & res$logFC >  lfc_thresh),
    n_down = sum(res$FDR < fdr_thresh & res$logFC < -lfc_thresh)
  )
})

pC_q2 <- if (nrow(de_counts_q2) > 0) {
  de_counts_q2 %>%
    mutate(contrast = factor(contrast, levels = rev(contrast))) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(n_up, n_down), names_to = "dir", values_to = "n") %>%
    mutate(n_plot = if_else(dir == "n_down", -n, n),
           dir_lab = if_else(dir == "n_up",
                             "Up regulated", "Down regulated")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(contrast, n_plot, fill = dir_lab)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
    geom_richtext(
    aes(
        label = scales::comma(abs(n)),
        y = n_plot + sign(n_plot) * 80),
    fill = "white",
    label.color = "darkgrey",  
    size = 3
) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Up regulated"   = "#D55E00",
      "Down regulated" = "#0072B2"
    )) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) scales::comma(abs(x))) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "DE gene count",
         fill  = NULL,
         title = "Differential expression gene counts \n( FDR < 0.05, |log₂FC| > 1)") +
    plot_theme +
       guides(fill="none")+
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
} else {
  ggplot() + annotate("text", x=0.5, y=0.5,
                      label="Run Q2 contrasts first", size=4) +
    theme_void() + labs(title="C  DE gene counts")
}
ggsave(file.path(outdir_summary, "Q2_plotC.png"),
       pC_q2, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 200)
# ---- D: Shared male-biased genes across germline and soma -----------------
if (!is.null(res_germline) && !is.null(res_soma_virgin)) {
  male_germ <- res_germline %>%
    filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, logFC < -lfc_thresh) %>% pull(gene)
  male_soma <- res_soma_virgin %>%
    filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, logFC < -lfc_thresh) %>% pull(gene)

  # Build a simple overlap dot chart (UpSet-style summary without the package)
  venn_df <- tibble(
    set  = c("Germline only", "Soma only", "Shared"),
    n    = c(
      length(setdiff(male_germ, male_soma)),
      length(setdiff(male_soma, male_germ)),
      length(intersect(male_germ, male_soma))
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(set = factor(set, levels = c("Germline only","Soma only","Shared")))

  pD_q2 <- ggplot(venn_df, aes(set, n, fill = set)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.55) +
    geom_richtext(
    aes(label = scales::comma(n)),
    fill = "white",
    label.color = "darkgrey",  
    size = 3
) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Germline only" = "#0072B2",
      "Shared"        = "#009E73",
      "Soma only"     = "#E69F00"
    )) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Gene count",
         title = "Overlap of male-biased\ngenes: germline vs soma") +
    plot_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))
} else {
  pD_q2 <- ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x=0.5, y=0.5, label="Data not found", size=4) +
    theme_void() + labs(title="D  Overlap")
}
ggsave(file.path(outdir_summary, "Q2_plotD.png"),
       pD_q2, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 200)
# ---- Assemble ---------------------------------------------------------------
```

```{r q2_go_heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
outdir_go_summary <- file.path(outdir_raw, "2_Sexual_dimorphism/summary_panels", "GO_heatmap")
dir.create(outdir_go_summary, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---- Load all short-genome GO summary files from q2 -----------------------
q2_go_files <- list.files(
  path       = file.path(outdir_raw, "02_Sexual_dimorphism"),
  pattern    = "GO_terms_merged\\.tsv$",
  recursive  = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
) %>%
  .[str_detect(., "short")]

message("q2 GO files found: ", length(q2_go_files))
print(q2_go_files)
# should be 2 because C2 has all 3 merged 
if (length(q2_go_files) == 0) stop("No q2 short GO files found — check paths")

# Read and label by contrast (parent folder name)
q2_go <- map_dfr(q2_go_files, function(f) {
  contrast <- basename(dirname(f))   # e.g. "contrast_1", "contrast_2"
  read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      weight01_fisher = as.character(weight01_fisher),
      contrast       = contrast,
      p_value        = parse_topgo_p(weight01_fisher),
      neg_log10p     = -log10(pmax(p_value, 1e-10)),
      contrast_group = paste0(contrast," | ", group)
    )
  
  
})

message("Total GO rows loaded: ", nrow(q2_go))
message("Contrast-groups found:")
print(unique(q2_go$contrast_group))

# ============================================================
# Helper: make heatmap from long GO data
#   x-axis (columns) = contrast_group
#   y-axis (rows)    = GO Term
#   fill             = -log10(p)
# ============================================================
make_contrast_go_heatmap <- function(go_data,
                                     title_text,
                                     n_terms     = 30,
                                     min_groups  = 2,
                                     p_threshold = 0.05) {
  
  # Keep terms significant in at least min_groups contrast-groups
  sig_terms <- go_data %>%
    filter(p_value < p_threshold) %>%
    dplyr::count(Term) %>%
    filter(n >= min_groups) %>%
    pull(Term)
  
  # If nothing is shared, take top terms by mean enrichment instead
  if (length(sig_terms) == 0) {
    message("No shared terms across groups — taking top terms by mean enrichment")
    sig_terms <- go_data %>%
      filter(p_value < p_threshold) %>%
      group_by(Term) %>%
      summarise(mean_p = mean(neg_log10p), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(desc(mean_p)) %>%
      slice_head(n = n_terms) %>%
      pull(Term)
  }
  
  if (length(sig_terms) == 0) {
    message("No significant GO terms found")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Build matrix: best p-value per term × contrast_group
  mat_long <- go_data %>%
    filter(Term %in% sig_terms) %>%
    group_by(Term, contrast_group) %>%
    slice_min(p_value, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(Term, contrast_group, neg_log10p)
  
  mat_wide <- mat_long %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from  = contrast_group,
                values_from = neg_log10p,
                values_fill = 0)
  
  # Select top n_terms by mean enrichment across all groups
  top_terms <- mat_wide %>%
    mutate(mean_p = rowMeans(across(-Term))) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_p)) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_terms) %>%
    pull(Term)
  
  mat <- mat_wide %>%
    filter(Term %in% top_terms) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Term") %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  mat[mat > 10] <- 10
  
  # Wrap long term names
  rownames(mat) <- str_trunc(rownames(mat), 50)
  
  # Row clustering
  if (nrow(mat) > 2) {
    row_order <- hclust(dist(mat), method = "ward.D2")$order
    mat       <- mat[row_order, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  
  pheatmap(
    mat,
    color             = colorRampPalette(c("#0072B2","white","#D55E00"))(100),
    cluster_rows      = FALSE,
    cluster_cols      = TRUE,
    clustering_method = "ward.D2",
    fontsize_row      = 9,
    fontsize_col      = 9,
    angle_col         = "45",
    main              = title_text,
    legend_breaks     = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10),
    legend_labels     = c("0","2","4","6","8","≥10")
  )
}

# ============================================================
# PLOT 1: All q2 contrasts in one heatmap
#   Columns = contrast | group (e.g. "contrast_1 | unfert")
#   Shows which GO terms are shared across MZT contrasts
#   and which are specific to one comparison
# ============================================================
p_q2_heatmap <- make_contrast_go_heatmap(
  go_data    = q2_go,
  title_text = "MZT: GO enrichment across all contrasts\n(−log₁₀ p)",
  n_terms    = 30,
  min_groups = 2
)
p_q2_heatmap<- wrap_elements(
  full = grid.grabExpr(ComplexHeatmap::draw( p_q2_heatmap)))
p_q2_heatmap
if (!is.null(p_q2_heatmap)) {

  ggsave(file.path(outdir_go_summary, "q2_GO_heatmap_all_contrasts.pdf"), p_q2_heatmap, width = 16, height = 10, dpi = 200)
  

}

# ============================================================
# PLOT 2: Faceted bar — top 8 terms per contrast-group
#   One panel per contrast-group
#   Good for seeing what each specific comparison is driven by
# ============================================================
p_q2_facet <- q2_go %>%
  filter(p_value < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(contrast_group) %>%
  slice_min(p_value, n = 8, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Term_short = str_trunc(Term, 40)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x      = reorder_within(Term_short, neg_log10p, contrast_group),
             y      = neg_log10p,
             fill   = neg_log10p)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ contrast_group, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_reordered() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = enrichment_palette(100),
                       name    = expression(-log[10](p))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    title    = "MZT: top GO terms per contrast group",
    subtitle = "Top 8 significant BP terms ( p < 0.05)",
    x = NULL, y = expression(-log[10](p))
  ) +
  plot_theme +
  theme(
    strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_q2_facet
ggsave(file.path(outdir_go_summary, "q2_GO_faceted_per_contrast.pdf"),
       p_q2_facet, width = 14, height = 0.6 * length(unique(q2_go$contrast_group)) + 4,
       limitsize = FALSE)


```

# Q3 – Post-mating transcriptional remodelling in females

> **Core question:** How does mating alter ovary biology relative to somatic tissues?

```{r q3_setup}
outdir_q3 <- file.path(outdir_raw, "3_PostMating")
dir.create(outdir_q3, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## C1 – Mated vs. virgin female abdomen

```{r q3_c1, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
outdir <- file.path(outdir_q3, "contrast_1")
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

meta <- meta_raw %>%
  filter(tissue == "AB", sex == "F", experiment =="1") %>%
  mutate(mating_grp = if_else(mating_status == "M",
                              "Mated_abdomen", "Virgin_abdomen"))

counts_short <- counts_short_raw[, meta$id, drop = FALSE]
counts_long <- counts_long_raw[, meta$id, drop = FALSE]
design        <- model.matrix(~ 0 + mating_grp, data = meta)
colnames(design) <- sub("mating_grp", "", colnames(design))
contrast_list <- list(mated_vs_virgin_abdomen = "Mated_abdomen - Virgin_abdomen")

results_all <- list(
  short = run_reference_analysis(counts_short, meta, design, contrast_list,
                                 "short", outdir, "mating_grp",
                                 min_count, min_samples, fdr_thresh, lfc_thresh),
    long = run_reference_analysis(counts_long, meta, design, contrast_list,
                                 "long", outdir, "mating_grp",
                                 min_count, min_samples, fdr_thresh, lfc_thresh)
)
saveRDS(results_all, file.path(outdir, "results_all_nested.rds"))
for (g in c("short","long"))
  append_de_stats(results_all, "Q3", "Female somvirgin vs mated",
                  "Mated_abdomen - Virgin_abdomen", genome = g)
```
### GO enrichment – C1

```{r q3_c1_go, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
for (genome in c("short", "long")) {
  geneID2GO <- get(paste0("geneID2GO_",      genome))
  gene_univ <- get(paste0("gene_universe_",   genome))
  res       <- results_all[[genome]]$contrasts$mated_vs_virgin_abdomen$table
  up_g      <- res %>% filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, logFC >  lfc_thresh) %>% pull(gene) %>% clean_ids()
  down_g    <- res %>% filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, logFC < -lfc_thresh) %>% pull(gene) %>% clean_ids()
  
  if (length(up_g) == 0 && length(down_g) == 0) {
    message("No significant DE genes for ", genome, " in C3.C1; skipping GO enrichment.")
    next
  }
  save_go_panel(run_topgo_all_ont(up_g, gene_univ, geneID2GO),
                run_topgo_all_ont(down_g, gene_univ, geneID2GO),
                outdir, paste0(genome))
  
 # outputGO 
  
  go_down <- run_topgo_all_ont(down_g, gene_univ, geneID2GO)
  go_up <- run_topgo_all_ont(up_g, gene_univ, geneID2GO)
  
  go_up_merged <- go_up %>% bind_rows() %>% mutate(group = "up")
  go_down_merged <-  go_down %>% bind_rows()%>% mutate(group = "down")
  
  go_merged <- rbind(go_up_merged, go_down_merged)
  write_tsv(go_merged, paste0(outdir,"/",genome,"GO_terms_merged.tsv"))
}
```

## C4 & C5 – Ovary vs. abdomen within mating status

```{r q3_c4c5, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
for (ms in c("V", "M")) {
  label  <- if (ms == "V") "virgin" else "mated"
  outdir <- file.path(outdir_q3, paste0("contrast_4/ovary_vs_abdomen_", label))
  dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  meta <- meta_raw %>%
    filter(sex == "F", tissue %in% c("OO", "YO", "AB"),
           mating_status == ms, experiment =="1") %>%
    mutate(tissue_grp = case_when(
      tissue %in% c("OO", "YO") ~ "Ovary",
      tissue == "AB"             ~ "Abdomen",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ))

  counts_short <- counts_short_raw[, meta$id, drop = FALSE]
counts_long <- counts_long_raw[, meta$id, drop = FALSE]
  design        <- model.matrix(~ 0 + tissue_grp, data = meta)
  colnames(design) <- sub("tissue_grp", "", colnames(design))
  contrast_list <- setNames(
    list("Ovary - Abdomen"),
    paste0("ovary_vs_abdomen_", label)
  )

results_all <- list(
  short = run_reference_analysis(counts_short, meta, design, contrast_list,
                                 "short", outdir, "tissue_grp",
                                 min_count, min_samples, fdr_thresh, lfc_thresh),
    long = run_reference_analysis(counts_long, meta, design, contrast_list,
                                 "long", outdir, "tissue_grp",
                                 min_count, min_samples, fdr_thresh, lfc_thresh)
)
  saveRDS(results_all, file.path(outdir, "results_all_nested.rds"))
  for (g in c("short","long"))
    append_de_stats(results_all, "Q3",
                    paste0(label," : abdomen vs ovary"),
                    "Ovary - Abdomen", genome = g)

  contrast <- names(contrast_list)
  ## GO terms
  for (genome in c("short", "long")) {
  geneID2GO <- get(paste0("geneID2GO_",      genome))
  gene_univ <- get(paste0("gene_universe_",   genome))
  res       <- results_all[[genome]]$contrasts[[contrast]]$table
  up_g      <- res %>% filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, logFC >  lfc_thresh) %>% pull(gene) %>% clean_ids()
  down_g    <- res %>% filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, logFC < -lfc_thresh) %>% pull(gene) %>% clean_ids()
  save_go_panel(run_topgo_all_ont(up_g, gene_univ, geneID2GO),
                run_topgo_all_ont(down_g, gene_univ, geneID2GO),
                outdir, paste0(genome))
  
   # outputGO 
  
  go_down <- run_topgo_all_ont(down_g, gene_univ, geneID2GO)
  go_up <- run_topgo_all_ont(up_g, gene_univ, geneID2GO)
  
  go_up_merged <- go_up %>% bind_rows() %>% mutate(group = "up")
  go_down_merged <-  go_down %>% bind_rows()%>% mutate(group = "down")
  
  go_merged <- rbind(go_up_merged, go_down_merged)
  write_tsv(go_merged, paste0(outdir,"/",genome,"GO_terms_merged.tsv"))

}
}
```

# SUMMARY PANEL 


```{r q3_summary_panel, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Q3 SUMMARY: Post-mating transcriptional remodelling in females
# Four-panel figure:
#   A. Mirror bar: DE gene counts across mated vs virgin contrasts per tissue
#   B. Volcano: mated vs virgin distal ovary (the strongest signal)
#   C. Dot plot: top DE genes shared across tissues post-mating
#   D. Tissue × mating_status heatmap of top DE genes (distal ovary signal)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


outdir_summary <- file.path(outdir_raw, "3_PostMating/summary_panels")
dir.create(outdir_summary, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Helper already defined above
load_short_res <- function(rds_path, contrast_name) {
  if (!file.exists(rds_path)) return(NULL)
  readRDS(rds_path)$short$contrasts[[contrast_name]]$table
}

q3_contrast_meta <- tribble(
  ~label,              ~rds_path,                              ~contrast_name,
  "Female soma - \n Virgin vs Mated",           "3_PostMating/contrast_1/results_all_nested.rds", "mated_vs_virgin_abdomen",
  
  "Proximal Ovary - \n Virgin vs Mated",    "3_PostMating/contrast_2/results_all_nested.rds", "mated_vs_virgin_OO",
  
    "Distal Ovary - \n Virgin vs Mated",      "3_PostMating/contrast_3/results_all_nested.rds", "mated_vs_virgin_YO",
  
  "Virgin:\n Abdomen vs Ovary",   "3_PostMating/contrast_4/ovary_vs_abdomen_virgin/results_all_nested.rds", "ovary_vs_abdomen_virgin",
  
  "Mated:\n Abdomen vs Ovary",    "3_PostMating/contrast_4/ovary_vs_abdomen_mated/results_all_nested.rds", "ovary_vs_abdomen_mated",

)

q3_res_list <- pmap(q3_contrast_meta,
                    function(label, rds_path, contrast_name, ...) {
  load_short_res(file.path(outdir_raw, rds_path), contrast_name)
}) %>% setNames(q3_contrast_meta$label)

# ---- A: Mirror bar of DE counts -------------------------------------------
de_counts_q3 <- pmap_dfr(q3_contrast_meta,
                          function(label, rds_path, contrast_name, ...) {
  res <- load_short_res(file.path(outdir_raw, rds_path), contrast_name)
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
  tibble(
    contrast = label,
    n_up   = sum(res$FDR < fdr_thresh & res$logFC >  lfc_thresh),
    n_down = sum(res$FDR < fdr_thresh & res$logFC < -lfc_thresh)
  )
})

pA_q3 <- if (nrow(de_counts_q3) > 0) {
  de_counts_q3 %>%
    mutate(contrast = factor(contrast, levels = rev(contrast))) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(n_up, n_down), names_to = "dir", values_to = "n") %>%
    mutate(n_plot  = if_else(dir == "n_down", -n, n),
           dir_lab = if_else(dir == "n_up",
                             "Up regulated", "Down regulated")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(contrast, n_plot, fill = dir_lab)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
geom_label_repel(
  aes(
    label = scales::comma(abs(n)),
    y = n_plot + sign(n_plot) * 80
  ),
  fill = "white",
  color = "darkgrey",
  size = 3
)+
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Up regulated" = "#D55E00" ,
      "Down regulated" = "#0072B2"
    )) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) scales::comma(abs(x))) +
    coord_flip() +
    guides(fill="none")+
    labs(x = NULL, y = "DE gene count", fill = NULL,
         title = "Differential expression gene counts \n(FDR < 0.05, |log₂FC| > 1)") +
    plot_theme + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  

} else {
  ggplot() + annotate("text",x=0.5,y=0.5,label="Run Q3 first",size=4) +
    theme_void() + labs(title="A  DE counts")
}
  ggsave(file.path(outdir_summary, "Q3_PA.png"),
       pA_q3, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 200)
# ---- B: Volcano — distal ovary (largest mating effect) --------------------
pB_q3 <- make_summary_volcano(
  q3_res_list[["Distal Ovary - \n Virgin vs Mated"]],
  "Disytal Ovary - Virgin vs Mated  ",
  pos_lab = "Mated-biased",
  neg_lab = "Virgin-biased"
)
  ggsave(file.path(outdir_summary, "Q3_PB.png"),
       pB_q3, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 200)
# ---- C: Shared up-regulated genes across mating-status contrasts -----------
# (abdomen, proximal ovary, distal ovary — the three tissue contrasts)
mating_tissue_contrasts <- c("Soma - \n Virgin vs Mated","Proximal Ovary - \n Virgin vs Mated","Distal Ovary - \n Virgin vs Mated")

up_sets <- lapply(mating_tissue_contrasts, function(tc) {
  res <- q3_res_list[[tc]]
  if (is.null(res)) return(character(0))
  res %>% filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, logFC > lfc_thresh) %>% pull(gene)
}) %>% setNames(mating_tissue_contrasts)

shared_up <- Reduce(intersect, Filter(function(x) length(x) > 0, up_sets))

shared_df <- tibble(
  set = c(names(up_sets), "Shared across\nall 3 tissues"),
  n   = c(sapply(up_sets, length), length(shared_up))
) 

pC_q3 <- ggplot(shared_df, aes(fct_reorder(set, -n), n, fill = set)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_richtext( aes( label = scales::comma(n)), fill = "white", label.color = "darkgrey", size = 3 ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Soma - \n Virgin vs Mated" = "#0072B2",
    "Proximal Ovary - \n Virgin vs Mated" = "#D55E00",
    "Distal Ovary - \n Virgin vs Mated" = "#CC79A7",
    "Shared across\nall 3 tissues" = "#000000"
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Up-regulated gene count",
       title = "Post-mating up-regulated genes\nper tissue (and shared)") +
  plot_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))
  ggsave(file.path(outdir_summary, "Q3_PC.png"),
       pC_q3, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 200)
  
# ---- D: Expression heatmap — top distal ovary DE genes across all tissues -
res_do <- q3_res_list[["Distal Ovary - \n Virgin vs Mated"]]

if (!is.null(res_do)) {
  top_do_genes <- res_do %>%
    filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, abs(logFC) >= lfc_thresh) %>%
    arrange(FDR) %>%
    slice_head(n = 40) %>%
    pull(gene)

  # Build expression matrix across ovary + abdomen samples
  meta_hm_q3 <- meta_raw %>%
    filter(tissue %in% c("YO","OO","AB"), sex == "F") %>%
    mutate(tissue_mating = paste0(
      recode(tissue, YO="Distal_OV", OO="Proximal_OV", AB="Abdomen"),
      "_", mating_status))

  if (nrow(meta_hm_q3) >= 3) {
    counts_hm_q3 <- counts_short_raw[, meta_hm_q3$id, drop = FALSE]
    dge_hm_q3 <- DGEList(counts = counts_hm_q3)
    keep_hm   <- rowSums(cpm(dge_hm_q3) >= 1) >= 2
    dge_hm_q3 <- dge_hm_q3[keep_hm, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
    dge_hm_q3 <- calcNormFactors(dge_hm_q3)
    lcpm_hm_q3 <- cpm(dge_hm_q3, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)

    genes_in_mat <- intersect(top_do_genes, rownames(lcpm_hm_q3))

    if (length(genes_in_mat) >= 2) {
      mat_q3 <- lcpm_hm_q3[genes_in_mat, , drop = FALSE]
      mat_q3_z <- t(scale(t(mat_q3)))
      mat_q3_z[mat_q3_z >  3] <-  3
      mat_q3_z[mat_q3_z < -3] <- -3

      ann_q3 <- meta_hm_q3 %>%
        dplyr::select(id, tissue_mating) %>%
        column_to_rownames("id")

    ann_colors <- list(
  tissue_mating = c(
    "Distal_OV_M"     = "#0072B2",
    "Distal_OV_V"     = "#56B4E9",
    "Proximal_OV_M"   = "#D55E00",
    "Proximal_OV_V"   = "#E69F00",
    "Abdomen_M"       = "#CC79A7",
    "Abdomen_V"       = "#E6A9C8",
    "Abdomen_NA"      = "#999999"
  )
)

      p_hm_q3 <- pheatmap(mat_q3_z,
               annotation_col    = ann_q3,
               annotation_colors = ann_colors,
               clustering_method = "ward.D2",
               show_row    = FALSE,
               show_colnames     = FALSE,
               color    = circlize::colorRamp2(
                 c(-3, 0, 3),
                 c("#0072B2","white","#D55E00"))(seq(-3, 3, length.out = 100)),
               main     = " Top DE genes \nacross all female tissues",
               silent   = TRUE)
      pD_q3 <- wrap_elements(
  full = grid.grabExpr(ComplexHeatmap::draw(p_hm_q3))
)
    } else {
      pD_q3 <- NULL
    }
  } else {
    pD_q3 <- NULL
  }
} else {
  pD_q3 <- NULL
}
  ggsave(file.path(outdir_summary, "Q3_PD.png"),
       pD_q3, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 200)
  
# ---- Assemble --------------------------------------------------------------
top_row   <- pA_q3 | pB_q3
bot_row   <- pC_q3 | pD_q3

p_q3_summary <- top_row / bot_row +
```
