# GO SUMMARY
```{r go_tissue_heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
outdir_gomap <- file.path(outdir_raw, "05_Tissue_landscapes", "GO_comparison")
dir.create(outdir_gomap, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Read the merged GO summary (built at end of build_tissue_landscape loop)
base_dir <- paste0(outdir_raw, "/5_Tissue_landscapes/Tissues")
merged_go <- read_tsv(
  file.path(base_dir, "merged_all_tissues_GO_summary.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Clean up p-values
merged_go <- merged_go %>%
  mutate(
    p_value    = parse_topgo_p(weight01_fisher),
    neg_log10p = -log10(pmax(p_value, 1e-10))
  )

# ============================================================
# PLOT 1: Heatmap — high expressed genes across all tissues
#   Rows = GO terms, Columns = tissue
#   Fill = -log10(p)
#   Shows which functional programmes are shared vs tissue-specific
# ============================================================

make_go_heatmap <- function(go_data, cls, title_text,
                             n_terms = 20, min_tissues = 2) {

  df <- go_data %>% filter(classification == cls)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

  # Keep terms that appear in at least min_tissues tissues
  term_freq <- df %>%
    filter(p_value < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::count(Term) %>%
    filter(n >= min_tissues) %>%
    pull(Term)

  if (length(term_freq) == 0) {
    message("No shared terms found for ", cls)
    return(NULL)
  }

  # For terms that appear in multiple tissues, take the most significant
  # p-value per tissue (some tissues have duplicates from both classes)
  mat_long <- df %>%
    filter(Term %in% term_freq) %>%
    group_by(Term, tissue) %>%
    slice_min(p_value, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(Term, tissue, neg_log10p)

  # Pivot to matrix: rows = terms, columns = tissues
  mat_wide <- mat_long %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from  = tissue,
                values_from = neg_log10p,
                values_fill = 0)

  # Select top n_terms by mean enrichment across tissues
  top_terms <- mat_wide %>%
    mutate(mean_p = rowMeans(across(-Term))) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_p)) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_terms) %>%
    pull(Term)

  mat <- mat_wide %>%
    filter(Term %in% top_terms) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Term") %>%
    as.matrix()

  # Cap at 10 for display
  mat[mat > 10] <- 10

  # Cluster rows by similarity so related terms group together
  row_order <- hclust(dist(mat), method = "ward.D2")$order
  mat       <- mat[row_order, , drop = FALSE]

  # Clean up tissue names for display
  colnames(mat) <- str_replace_all(colnames(mat), "_", " ")

  pheatmap(
    mat,
    color             = colorRampPalette(c("#0072B2","white","#D55E00"))(100),
    cluster_rows      = FALSE,   # already ordered above
    cluster_cols      = TRUE,
    clustering_method = "ward.D2",
    fontsize_row      = 9,
    fontsize_col      = 10,
    angle_col         = "45",
    main              = title_text,
    legend_breaks     = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10),
    legend_labels     = c("0", "2", "4", "6", "8", "≥10")
  )
}

# ---- High expressed genes -------------------------------------------------
p_high <- make_go_heatmap(
  merged_go,
  cls        = "high",
  title_text = "GO enrichment — high expressed genes\n(−log₁₀ p, shared terms across ≥ 2 tissues)",
  n_terms    = 25,
  min_tissues = 2
)

if (!is.null(p_high)) {

      width = 10, height = 8)

}

  merged_go,
  cls        = "medium",
  title_text = "GO enrichment — medium expressed genes\n(−log₁₀ p, shared terms across ≥ 2 tissues)",
  n_terms    = 25,
  min_tissues = 2
)

if (!is.null(p_med)) {
  pdf(file.path(outdir_gomap, "GO_heatmap_medium_expressed.pdf"),
      width = 10, height = 8)
```

# Global tissue atlas — PCA / UMAP

> Visualise all tissues and sexes in a single reduced-dimension plot to show that **tissue identity** explains more variance than **sex** or **mating status**.

```{r global_atlas, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
outdir_atlas <- file.path(outdir_raw, "6_Global_atlas")
dir.create(outdir_atlas, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Use adult tissues only (exclude embryos for this comparison)
adult_tissues <- c("AG", "AB", "TE", "YO", "OO")
meta_adult    <- meta_raw %>%
  filter(tissue %in% adult_tissues) %>%
  mutate(
    tissue_label = recode(tissue, !!!setNames(as.character(tissues[adult_tissues]),
                                              adult_tissues)),
    group_label  = paste0(tissue_label,
                          if_else(tissue == "AB",
                                  paste0("_", sex,
                                         if_else(!is.na(mating_status),
                                                 paste0("_", mating_status), "")),
                                  ""))
  )

counts_adult <- counts_short_raw[, meta_adult$id, drop = FALSE]

dge_adult  <- DGEList(counts = counts_adult)
keep_adult <- rowSums(cpm(dge_adult) >= 1) >= 2
dge_adult  <- dge_adult[keep_adult, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
dge_adult  <- calcNormFactors(dge_adult)
lcpm_adult <- cpm(dge_adult, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)

# ---- PCA (top 5,000 variable genes) ---------------------------------------
top5k_a <- names(sort(rowVars(lcpm_adult), decreasing = TRUE))[1:5000]
pca_a   <- prcomp(t(lcpm_adult[top5k_a, ]), scale. = TRUE)
vexp_a  <- pca_a$sdev^2 / sum(pca_a$sdev^2)

pca_df_a <- as.data.frame(pca_a$x[, 1:3]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("id") %>%
  left_join(meta_adult, by = "id")

# Scree plot

p_scree  <- ggplot(scree_df, aes(PC, var_exp)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#0072B2") +
  geom_line(colour = "#D55E00") +

  labs(title = "Global atlas — PCA scree", x = "PC", y = "% variance explained") +
  plot_theme

       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(vexp_a[2]*100,1), "%)"),
```

# Tissue-specificity scores (tau index)

> Quantify how broadly vs. narrowly each gene is expressed across the tissue panel. **Tau = 1** → tissue-specific; **tau = 0** → ubiquitous.
> Based on Yanai *et al.* (2005) *Bioinformatics*.

```{r tau_index, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
outdir_tau <- file.path(outdir_raw, "7_Tau_specificity")
dir.create(outdir_tau, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Compute mean CPM per tissue (adult only)
mean_cpm_per_tissue <- lapply(names(tissues), function(tc) {
  ids <- meta_raw$id[meta_raw$tissue == tc]
  ids <- intersect(ids, colnames(lcpm_adult))
  if (length(ids) == 0) return(NULL)
  rowMeans(2^lcpm_adult[, ids, drop = FALSE] - 1)  # back to CPM
}) %>%
  setNames(names(tissues)) %>%
  Filter(Negate(is.null), .)

# Keep only tissues with data and genes present in all tissues
common_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(mean_cpm_per_tissue, names))
tau_mat      <- do.call(cbind,
                        lapply(mean_cpm_per_tissue, function(x) x[common_genes]))
colnames(tau_mat) <- names(mean_cpm_per_tissue)

tau_scores <- calc_tau(tau_mat)

tau_df <- tibble(gene = names(tau_scores), tau = tau_scores) %>%
  filter(!is.na(tau)) %>%
  arrange(desc(tau))

write_tsv(tau_df, file.path(outdir_tau, "tau_scores.tsv"))

# Distribution plot
p_tau_dist <- ggplot(tau_df, aes(tau)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "#0072B2", colour = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.85, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "#D55E00") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.87, y = Inf, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.5,
           label = "τ > 0.85\n(tissue-specific)", size = 3.5,
           colour = "#D55E00") +
  labs(title = "Tissue-specificity distribution — tau index",
       x = "Tau (0 = ubiquitous, 1 = tissue-specific)",
       y = "Gene count") +
  plot_theme
p_tau_dist
ggsave(file.path(outdir_tau, "tau_distribution.pdf"), p_tau_dist,
       width = 7, height = 5)

# Top 20 tissue-specific genes per tissue
for (tc in colnames(tau_mat)) {
  tissue_specific <- tau_df %>%
    filter(tau > 0.85) %>%
    arrange(desc(tau_mat[gene, tc])) %>%
    slice_head(n = 20)
  message(tc, ": ", nrow(tissue_specific),
          " high-tau genes (top 20 shown)")
}

# Heatmap of top 200 tissue-specific genes
top200 <- tau_df %>% slice_head(n = 200) %>% pull(gene)
mat_tau <- log2(tau_mat[top200, ] + 1)

ann_col_tau <- data.frame(
  tissue = colnames(mat_tau), row.names = colnames(mat_tau))

pheatmap(t(mat_tau),
         annotation_row = ann_col_tau,
         clustering_method = "ward.D2",
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         color    = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#D55E00"))(100),
         filename = file.path(outdir_tau, "tau_top200_heatmap.pdf"),
         width = 12, height = 5)
```

# UpSet plot — sex-biased gene overlap across tissues

> Are the same genes driving sexual dimorphism in germline and soma, or are they independent sets?
> Mirrors the approach of Assis *et al.* (2012) *PLoS Genetics* and Graveley *et al.* (2011) for tissue-specific DE.

```{r upset_sex, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
outdir_upset <- file.path(outdir_raw, "8_UpSet_sex_bias")
dir.create(outdir_upset, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Load all Q2 contrast results (short genome)
contrast_files <- list(
  Germline   = file.path(outdir_raw, "2_Sexual_dimorphism/contrast_1/results_all_nested.rds"),
  Abdomen_V  = file.path(outdir_raw, "2_Sexual_dimorphism/contrast_3/results_all_nested.rds"),
  Abdomen_M  = file.path(outdir_raw, "2_Sexual_dimorphism/contrast_4/results_all_nested.rds")
)

de_sets <- lapply(contrast_files, function(f) {
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(list(male_biased = character(), female_biased = character()))
  res_obj <- readRDS(f)
  cname   <- names(res_obj$short$contrasts)[1]
  res     <- res_obj$short$contrasts[[cname]]$table
  list(
    male_biased   = res %>% filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, logFC < -lfc_thresh) %>%
      pull(gene),
    female_biased = res %>% filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, logFC >  lfc_thresh) %>%
      pull(gene)
  )
})

# Build UpSet input list
results_list <- list()

for (direction in c("male_biased", "female_biased")) {
  set_list <- lapply(de_sets, `[[`, direction)
  set_list <- Filter(function(x) length(x) > 0, set_list)

  if (length(set_list) < 2) next

   p<- upset(fromList(set_list),
        order.by  = "freq",
        sets.bar.color = "#D55E00",
        main.bar.color = "#0072B2",
        text.scale = 1.4,
        mainbar.y.label = paste(direction, "gene count"),
        sets.x.label    = "Total DE genes")
  
  pdf(file.path(outdir_upset, paste0("UpSet_", direction, ".pdf")),
      width = 10, height = 6)
print(p)
  dev.off()

  # Genes shared across ALL tissues (most stringent sex-biased set)
  shared_all <- Reduce(intersect, set_list)
  message(direction, " — shared across all tissues: ", length(shared_all))
  
  if (length(shared_all) > 0) {
    write_lines(shared_all,
                file.path(outdir_upset,
                          paste0(direction, "_shared_all_tissues.txt")))
    # GO for the shared core
    go_shared <- run_topgo_all_ont(clean_ids(shared_all),
                                   gene_universe_short, geneID2GO_short)
    p_shared  <- plot_topgo_panel(go_shared,
                                  paste0(direction, " — shared across tissues"))
    if (!is.null(p_shared))
      ggsave(file.path(outdir_upset,
                       paste0("GO_", direction, "_shared_all.pdf")),
             p_shared, width = 8, height = 10)
    
          summary_cls <- plot_topgo_bar(go_shared)
       if (!is.null(summary_cls))
        ggsave(file.path(outdir_upset, paste0( "_GO_Summary_",direction ,".pdf")),
               summary_cls, width = 7, height = 6)
      
      # save summary file 
       topgo_df <- go_shared$BP
  if (is.null(topgo_df) || nrow(topgo_df) == 0) return(NULL)
 
  df <- topgo_df %>%
    mutate(p_value     = parse_topgo_p(weight01_fisher),
           Significant = as.numeric(Significant)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(0.05), !is.na(Significant)) %>%
    arrange(p_value) %>%
    slice_head(n = 12) 
 
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
 
  # save summary file 
      write_tsv(df,file.path(outdir_upset, paste0( "_GO_Summary_", direction , ".tsv")))
  
      
      results_list[[direction]] <- list (
        p = p,
        p_shared = p_shared,
        summary_cls = summary_cls
      )
  }
}

saveRDS(results_list, file.path(outdir_upset, paste0("go_summary_upset.RDS")))
```

# Transcription factor enrichment (HOMER motif analysis)

> Identify overrepresented transcription factor binding motifs in the promoters of sex-biased and post-mating DE gene sets.
> Calls HOMER `findMotifs.pl` from R via `system()`. Requires HOMER installed and a genome FASTA.


MAC
•Install required dependencies:

brew install perl
brew install wget
brew install cpanminus
brew install gcc
brew install gnu-sed
brew install coreutils
brew install gffread

-------

•Download Homer 

cd ~
mkdir -p ~/tools/HOMER
cd ~/tools/HOMER
wget http://homer.ucsd.edu/homer/configureHomer.pl
perl configureHomer.pl -install

-------

•add HOMER to PATH

nano ~/.tcshrc
setenv PATH ${PATH}:/path/to/your/HOMER/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin
setenv PATH ${PATH}:/path/to/your/HOMER/bin

-------

• check it worked 
source ~/.tcshrc
which findMotifs.pl 
findMotifs.pl

-------

•Download Genome

mkdir -p ~/homer_genomes/ccap
cd ~/homer_genomes/ccap

wget https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/347/755/GCF_000347755.3_Ccap_2.1/GCF_000347755.3_Ccap_2.1_genomic.fna.gz
wget https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/347/755/GCF_000347755.3_Ccap_2.1/GCF_000347755.3_Ccap_2.1_genomic.gff.gz

gunzip GCF_000347755.3_Ccap_2.1_genomic.fna.gz
gunzip GCF_000347755.3_Ccap_2.1_genomic.gff.gz

-------

•Prep genome 

gffread GCF_000347755.3_Ccap_2.1_genomic.gff -T -o Ccap.gtf
  
-------
  
• create HOMER genome 
perl ~/tools/HOMER/bin/loadGenome.pl \
  -name Ccap \
  -fasta ~/homer_genomes/ccap/GCF_000347755.3_Ccap_2.1_genomic.fna \
  -gtf   ~/homer_genomes/ccap/Ccap.gtf \
  -org null
perl ~/tools/HOMER/bin/printGenomes.pl

-------

• make sure R knows Homer path - IN R 
Sys.setenv(PATH = paste(
  "/path/to/your/HOMER/bin",
  Sys.getenv("PATH"),
  sep = ":"
))

```{r homer_setup, eval=FALSE}
# Set paths — adjust to your HOMER installation
HOMER_PATH   <- "/path/to/your/HOMER/bin"
GENOME_FASTA <- here("data/Genomic_files/GCF_000347755.3_Ccap_2.1_genomic.fna")
GFF_FILE <- here("data/Genomic_files/GCF_000347755.3_Ccap_2.1_genomic.gff")
HOMER_SIZE   <- 1000   # promoter window (bp upstream of TSS)

outdir_homer <- file.path(outdir_raw, "9_HOMER_motifs")
dir.create(outdir_homer, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Helper: extract promoter BED from gene list
genes_to_promoter_bed <- function(gene_ids, gff_file,
                                   upstream = 1000, downstream = 100) {
  gff <- read_tsv(gff_file, comment = "#",
                  col_names = c("seqid","source","type","start","end",
                                "score","strand","phase","attributes"),
                  show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(type == "gene") %>%
    mutate(gene = str_extract(attributes, "(?<=gene=)[^;]+"),
           locus = str_extract(attributes, "(?<=locus_tag=)[^;]+"),
           gene_id = coalesce(gene, locus)) %>%
    filter(gene_id %in% gene_ids)

  gff %>%
    transmute(
      chrom  = seqid,
      prom_start = if_else(strand == "+",
                           pmax(0, start - upstream),
                           end - downstream),
      prom_end   = if_else(strand == "+",
                           start + downstream,
                           end + upstream),
      name   = gene_id,
      score  = 0,
      strand = strand
    )
}

# Helper: run HOMER findMotifs.pl
run_homer <- function(target_genes, background_genes, label,
                      gff_file = GFF_FILE,
                      genome_fa = GENOME_FASTA) {

  outdir_h <- file.path(outdir_homer, label)
  dir.create(outdir_h, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  tgt_bed <- genes_to_promoter_bed(target_genes, gff_file)
  bg_bed  <- genes_to_promoter_bed(background_genes, gff_file)

  tgt_file <- file.path(outdir_h, "target_promoters.bed")
  bg_file  <- file.path(outdir_h, "background_promoters.bed")

  write_tsv(tgt_bed, tgt_file, col_names = FALSE)
  write_tsv(bg_bed,  bg_file,  col_names = FALSE)

  cmd <- paste0(
    file.path(HOMER_PATH, "findMotifsGenome.pl"),
    " ", tgt_file,
    " ", genome_fa,
    " ", outdir_h,
    " -bg ", bg_file,
    " -size ", HOMER_SIZE,
    " -len 6,8,10",
    " -p 4"        # threads
  )
  message("Running HOMER: ", label)
  system(cmd)
}

# Run for germline sex-biased genes
germ_res    <- readRDS(file.path(outdir_raw,
                                 "2_Sexual_dimorphism/contrast_1/results_all_nested.rds"))
germ_table  <- germ_res$short$contrasts$female_gonad_vs_male_gonad$table

male_biased_germ   <- germ_table %>%
  filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, logFC < -lfc_thresh) %>% pull(gene)
female_biased_germ <- germ_table %>%
  filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, logFC >  lfc_thresh) %>% pull(gene)
background_germ    <- germ_table$gene

run_homer(male_biased_germ,   background_germ, "germline_male_biased")
run_homer(female_biased_germ, background_germ, "germline_female_biased")

# Run for post-mating distal ovary (immune activation set)
pm_res   <- readRDS(file.path(outdir_raw,
                               "3_PostMating/contrast_3/results_all_nested.rds"))
pm_table <- pm_res$short$contrasts$mated_vs_virgin_YO$table
pm_up    <- pm_table %>% filter(FDR < fdr_thresh, logFC >  lfc_thresh) %>% pull(gene)
run_homer(pm_up, pm_table$gene, "postmating_DO_upregulated")
```

## Homer results plots

Read HOMER knownResults.txt for each contrast and plot top motifs
File is tab-separated with columns:
Motif Name, Consensus, P-value, Log P-value, q-value (Benjamini), of Target Sequences with Motif, % of Target Sequences with Motif, # of Background Sequences with Motif, % of Background Sequences with Motif

```{r homer_results_plot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

outdir_homer <- file.path(outdir_raw, "9_HOMER_motifs")
dir.create(outdir_homer, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

read_homer_known <- function(label) {
  f <- file.path(outdir_homer, label, "knownResults.txt")
  if (!file.exists(f)) {
    message("Not found: ", f)
    return(NULL)
  }
  read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    setNames(c("motif_name","consensus","pvalue","log_pvalue",
               "q_value","n_target","pct_target","n_bg","pct_bg")) %>%
    mutate(
      label       = label,
      pct_target  = as.numeric(str_remove(pct_target, "%")),
      pct_bg      = as.numeric(str_remove(pct_bg,     "%")),
      log10p      = -log_pvalue / log(10),   # HOMER gives natural log
      fold_enrich = pct_target / pct_bg,
      # Clean up motif name — HOMER appends "/Motif Family/Accession"
      tf_name     = str_extract(motif_name, "^[^/]+")
    ) %>%
    arrange(log10p)
}

homer_sets <- list(
  "germline_male_biased"     = read_homer_known("germline_male_biased"),
  "germline_female_biased"   = read_homer_known("germline_female_biased"),
  "postmating_DO_upregulated" = read_homer_known("postmating_DO_upregulated")
)

# ---- Plot: top 15 known motifs per contrast --------------------------------
plot_homer <- function(df, title_text, n_top = 15, q_thresh = 0.05) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df_plot <- df %>%
    filter(q_value < q_thresh) %>%
    arrange(desc(log10p)) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_top) %>%
    mutate(tf_name = factor(tf_name, levels = rev(tf_name)))
  
  if (nrow(df_plot) == 0) {
    message("No significant motifs (q < ", q_thresh, ") for: ", title_text)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  ggplot(df_plot, aes(tf_name, log10p, fill = fold_enrich)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed",
               colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.5) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = enrichment_palette(100),
      name    = "Fold\nenrichment\n(% target /\n% background)"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
    labs(
      title    = title_text,
      subtitle = paste0("Top ", nrow(df_plot),
                        " known motifs (q < ", q_thresh, ")"),
      x = NULL,
      y = expression(-log[10](p))
    ) +
    plot_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
}

p_homer_male   <- plot_homer(homer_sets$germline_male_biased,
                              "Motifs enriched in testis-biased gene promoters")
p_homer_female <- plot_homer(homer_sets$germline_female_biased,
                              "Motifs enriched in ovary-biased gene promoters")
p_homer_pm     <- plot_homer(homer_sets$postmating_DO_upregulated,
                              "Motifs enriched in post-mating distal ovary gene promoters")

# Save individual plots
outdir_homer_plots <- file.path(outdir_raw, "9_HOMER_motifs", "plots")
dir.create(outdir_homer_plots, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (nm in names(homer_sets)) {
  p <- plot_homer(homer_sets[[nm]], nm)
  if (!is.null(p))
    ggsave(file.path(outdir_homer_plots, paste0(nm, "_known_motifs.pdf")),
           p, width = 9, height = 6)
}

# ---- Combined patchwork panel ----------------------------------------------
plots_combined <- Filter(Negate(is.null),
                          list(p_homer_male, p_homer_female, p_homer_pm))

if (length(plots_combined) > 0) {
  p_homer_panel <- wrap_plots(plots_combined, ncol = 1) +
    plot_annotation(
      title    = "Transcription factor motif enrichment — HOMER",
      subtitle = "Known motifs in promoters of DE gene sets (1 kb upstream of TSS)",
      tag_levels = "A"
    )
  ggsave(file.path(outdir_homer_plots, "HOMER_motif_panel.pdf"),
         p_homer_panel,
         width  = 10,
         height = 5 * length(plots_combined),
         limitsize = FALSE)
  p_homer_panel
}
```

# Cross-tissue germline–soma correlation

> Do testes and ovary share the same biosynthetic identity, or are their transcriptomes fundamentally different despite both being germline?

```{r cross_tissue_cor, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
outdir_cor <- file.path(outdir_raw, "10_CrossTissue_correlation")
dir.create(outdir_cor, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Mean logCPM per tissue (all samples, short genome)
get_tissue_mean <- function(tc) {
  ids <- meta_raw %>% filter(tissue == tc) %>% pull(id)
  ids <- intersect(ids, colnames(lcpm_adult))
  if (length(ids) == 0) return(NULL)
  rowMeans(lcpm_adult[, ids, drop = FALSE])
}

tissue_means <- lapply(names(tissues), get_tissue_mean)
names(tissue_means) <- names(tissues)
tissue_means <- Filter(Negate(is.null), tissue_means)

# Restrict to common genes
cg <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(tissue_means, names))
mean_mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(tissue_means, function(x) x[cg]))
colnames(mean_mat) <- tissues[colnames(mean_mat)]

# Pairwise Spearman correlation
cor_mat <- cor(mean_mat, method = "spearman")

# Heatmap
pdf(file.path(outdir_cor, "tissue_spearman_correlation.pdf"),
    width = 7, height = 6)
pheatmap(cor_mat,
         color    = colorRampPalette(c("#0072B2", "white", "#D55E00"))(100),
         breaks   = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 101),
         display_numbers = TRUE,
         number_format   = "%.2f",
         fontsize_number = 10,
         clustering_method = "ward.D2",
         main = "Tissue–tissue Spearman correlation (mean logCPM)")
dev.off()

# Scatter: testes vs distal ovary (germline comparison)
if ("TE" %in% names(tissue_means) && "YO" %in% names(tissue_means)) {
  scatter_df <- tibble(
    gene         = cg,
    Testes       = mean_mat[, "Testes"],
    Distal_Ovary = mean_mat[, "Distal_Ovary"]
  ) %>%
    mutate(diff = abs(Testes - Distal_Ovary),
           label_gene = if_else(rank(-diff) <= 20, gene, ""))

  p_germ_scatter <- ggplot(scatter_df, aes(Testes, Distal_Ovary)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 1, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE,
                colour = "#D55E00") +
    geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = label_gene), size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 20) +
    labs(title = "Germline comparison: testes vs distal ovary",
         subtitle = paste0("Spearman ρ = ",
                           round(cor_mat["Testes","Distal_Ovary"], 3)),
         x = "Testes (mean log₂CPM)",
         y = "Distal ovary (mean log₂CPM)") +
    plot_theme
  p_germ_scatter
  ggsave(file.path(outdir_cor, "scatter_testes_vs_distal_ovary.pdf"),
         p_germ_scatter, width = 7, height = 6)
}
```

# Master DE statistics table — final display

```{r de_master_display, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Print and save the completed DE statistics master table
# ===========================================================================

if (file.exists(de_master_file)) {
  de_master <- read_tsv(de_master_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

  # Pivot to wide: short and long side-by-side for easy comparison
  de_wide <- de_master %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols     = c(section, question, contrast),
      names_from  = genome,
      values_from = c(n_tested, n_up, n_down, n_sig_total, pct_sig),
      names_sep   = "_"
    ) %>%
    arrange(section, question)

  write_tsv(de_wide,
            file.path(outdir_raw, "DE_stats_master_wide.tsv"))

  # Summary bar: total DE genes per section (short genome only)
  de_section_summary <- de_master %>%
    filter(genome == "short") %>%
    group_by(section) %>%
    summarise(
      total_contrasts = n(),
      total_up        = sum(n_up),
      total_down      = sum(n_down),
      total_DE        = sum(n_sig_total),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  p_de_overview <- de_master %>%
    filter(genome == "short") %>%
    mutate(
      label = paste0(section, ": ", str_trunc(question, 35)),
      label = fct_inorder(label)
    ) %>%
   
    pivot_longer(c(n_up, n_down), names_to = "dir", values_to = "n") %>%
    mutate(n_plot  = if_else(dir == "n_down", -n, n),
           dir_lab = if_else(dir == "n_up", "Up", "Down")) %>%
     mutate(
  label_pos = case_when(
    abs(n_plot) < 100 ~ n_plot + sign(n_plot) * 500,
    TRUE              ~ n_plot * 0.9
  ) # if DE count is low increat the distance between labels 
) %>%
    ggplot(aes(label, n_plot, fill = dir_lab)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
geom_richtext(
  aes(
    label = scales::comma(abs(n_plot)),
    y = label_pos
  ),
  fill = "white",
  label.color = "darkgrey",
  size = 3
) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Up = "#D55E00",
                                 Down = "#0072B2")) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) scales::comma(abs(x))) +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_grid(section ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "DE gene count",
         fill = NULL,
         title = "DE gene counts across all contrasts",
         subtitle = "FDR < 0.05  |  |log₂FC| > 1") +
    plot_theme +
    theme(
      legend.position   = "bottom",
      strip.text.y      = element_text(angle = 0, size = 9),
      axis.text.y       = element_text(size = 8)
    )+
    guides(fill="none")

  ggsave(file.path(outdir_raw, "DE_overview_all_contrasts.pdf"),
         p_de_overview,
         width  = 12,
         height = 0.35 * nrow(de_master[de_master$genome=="short",]) + 3,
         limitsize = FALSE)
  ggsave(file.path(outdir_raw, "DE_overview_all_contrasts.png"),
         p_de_overview,
         width  = 12,
         height = 0.35 * nrow(de_master[de_master$genome=="short",]) + 3,
         dpi = 200, limitsize = FALSE)

  p_de_overview

  # Print wide table as knitr table
  knitr::kable(
    de_wide,
    caption = "DE statistics — all contrasts (short and long genome)",
    format  = "html"
  )

} else {
  message("DE master file not found — run contrasts first.")
}
```
